name: limsup_eq_neg_liminf_neg
statement:
private theorem limsup_eq_neg_liminf_neg {fn : ℕ → ℝ} {_lb _ub : ℝ}Expand commentComment on line R131Resolved
    (hl : ∀ n, _lb ≤ fn n) (hu : ∀ n, fn n ≤ _ub) :
    Filter.atTop.limsup fn = -Filter.atTop.liminf (fun n => -fn n)
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : -Filter.atTop.limsup fn = Filter.atTop.liminf (fun n => -fn n) := by
    have hdual := OrderIso.limsup_apply (f := Filter.atTop) (u := fn) realNegOrderIso
      (hu := Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (f := Filter.atTop) (u := fn)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hu))
      (hu_co := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le Filter.atTop hl)
      (hgu := Filter.isBoundedUnder_of_eventually_le (α := ℝᵒᵈ) (f := Filter.atTop)
        (u := fun n => (-fn n : ℝᵒᵈ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => neg_le_neg (hu n)))
      (hgu_co := Filter.isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le (α := ℝᵒᵈ) Filter.atTop
        (f := fun n => (-fn n : ℝᵒᵈ)) (x := (-_lb : ℝᵒᵈ)) fun n => neg_le_neg (hl n))
    simpa [Filter.limsup, Filter.liminf, Filter.limsSup, Filter.limsInf, realNegOrderIso] using
      congrArg OrderDual.ofDual hdual
  linarith

name: InfRegularized.to_SupRegularized
statement:
theorem InfRegularized.to_SupRegularized : InfRegularized fn hl hu = -SupRegularized (-fn ·)
    (lb := -_ub) (ub := -_lb) (neg_le_neg_iff.mpr <| hu ·) (neg_le_neg_iff.mpr <| hl ·)
proof:
:= by
  have liminf_neg : Filter.liminf fn Filter.atTop = -(Filter.limsup (-fn) Filter.atTop) := by
    simp [Filter.limsup_eq, Filter.liminf_eq, Real.sInf_def]
  exact Real.ext_cauchy (congrArg Real.cauchy liminf_neg)

name: SupRegularized.to_InfRegularized
statement:
theorem SupRegularized.to_InfRegularized : SupRegularized fn hl hu = -InfRegularized (-fn ·)
    (lb := -_ub) (ub := -_lb) (neg_le_neg_iff.mpr <| hu ·) (neg_le_neg_iff.mpr <| hl ·)
proof:
:= by
  unfold InfRegularized SupRegularized
  exact limsup_eq_neg_liminf_neg hl hu

name: InfRegularized.of_Subadditive
statement:
theorem InfRegularized.of_Subadditive (hf : Subadditive (fun n ↦ fn n * n))
    :
    hf.lim = InfRegularized fn hl hu
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := hf.tendsto_lim (by
    use min 0 _lb
    rw [mem_lowerBounds]
    rintro x ⟨y,(rfl : _ / _ = _)⟩
    rcases y with (_|n)
    · simp
    · rw [inf_le_iff]
      convert Or.inr (hl (n+1))
      field_simp
  )
  have h₂ : Filter.Tendsto fn .atTop (nhds hf.lim) := by
    refine h₁.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ne_atTop 0] with n hn
    have : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn
    field_simp
  exact h₂.liminf_eq.symm

name: prod_diagonal_comp_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin (d + 1)) = Fintype.card (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) := by

  have hbij : Function.Bijective v :=
    (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card v).mpr ⟨hv, hcard⟩

name: mem_adjoin_imp_subtype_in_range
statement:
private lemma mem_adjoin_imp_subtype_in_range (m : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ)
    (hm : m ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℝ γSet) : ⟨m, hm⟩ ∈ ofCliffordAlgebra.range
proof:
:= by
  induction hm using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact γ_subtype_in_range i
  | algebraMap r =>
    
    use algebraMap ℝ _ r
    ext
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | add y z _ _ hy hz =>
    
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hz
    use y' + z'
    ext : 1
    have hy'' : (ofCliffordAlgebra y' : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) = y := congr_arg Subtype.val hy'
    have hz'' : (ofCliffordAlgebra z' : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) = z := congr_arg Subtype.val hz'
    simp [hy'', hz'']
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hz
    use y' * z'
    ext : 1
    have hy'' : (ofCliffordAlgebra y' : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) = y := congr_arg Subtype.val hy'
    have hz'' : (ofCliffordAlgebra z' : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ) = z := congr_arg Subtype.val hz'
    simp [hy'', hz'']

    finCongr_symm, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.sumCongr_symm, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
    Equiv.coe_refl, Sum.map_inr, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
  change (finSumFinEquiv
    (Sum.map (⇑(finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans (Equiv.sumComm (Fin ↑i) (Fin 1))).symm) id
    ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin 1) (Fin ↑i) (Fin (n - i))).symm
    (Sum.inr (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.cast _ x)))))).val = _
  by_cases hi : x.1 < i.1
  · generalize_proofs hp
    have h1 : (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.cast hp x)) =
        Sum.inl ⟨x, hi⟩ := by
      rw [← finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd]
      rfl
    rw [h1]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Equiv.sumAssoc_symm_apply_inr_inl, Sum.map_inl,
      Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.sumComm_symm, Equiv.sumComm_apply,
      Sum.swap_inr, finSumFinEquiv_apply_left, Fin.castAdd_mk]
    rw [Fin.succAbove]
    split
    · rfl
    rename_i hn
    simp_all only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, not_lt, Fin.le_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ,
      left_eq_add, one_ne_zero]
    omega
  · generalize_proofs hp
    have h1 : (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.cast hp x)) =
        Sum.inr ⟨x - i, by omega⟩ := by
      rw [← finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd]
      apply congrArg
      ext
      simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.val_cast, Fin.natAdd_mk]
      omega
    rw [h1, Fin.succAbove]
    split
    · rename_i hn
      simp_all [Fin.lt_def]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Equiv.sumAssoc_symm_apply_inr_inr, Sum.map_inr, id_eq,
      finSumFinEquiv_apply_right, Fin.natAdd_mk, Fin.val_succ]
    omega

    crossProductMatrix (crossProductVee A) = A
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ i j, A i j = - A j i := fun i j => by
    simpa using congrFun (congrFun hA j) i
  have hdiag : ∀ i, A i i = 0 := fun i => CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff.mp (h i i)
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [crossProductVee, crossProductMatrix] <;>
    first
      | exact (h _ _).symm
      | exact (hdiag _).symm

name: takeWhile_eraseIdx
statement:
lemma takeWhile_eraseIdx {I : Type} (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (l : List I) → (i : ℕ) → (hi : ∀ (i j : Fin l.length), i < j → P (l.get j) → P (l.get i)) →
    List.takeWhile P (List.eraseIdx l i) = (List.takeWhile P l).eraseIdx i
  | [], _, h => by
    rfl
  | a :: [], 0, h => by
    simp only [List.takeWhile, List.eraseIdx_zero]
    split <;> rfl
  | a :: [], Nat.succ n, h => by
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.eraseIdx_nil]
    rw [List.eraseIdx_of_length_le ((List.takeWhile_sublist _).length_le.trans (by simp))]
  | a :: b :: l, 0, h => by
    simp only [List.takeWhile, List.eraseIdx_zero]
    by_cases hPb : P b
    · have hPa : P a
proof:
:= by
        simpa using h ⟨0, by simp⟩ ⟨1, by simp⟩ (by simp) (by simpa using hPb)
      simp [hPb, hPa]
    · simp [hPb]
      split <;> rfl
  | a :: b :: l, Nat.succ n, h => by
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]
    by_cases hPa : P a
    · dsimp only [List.takeWhile]
      simp only [hPa, decide_true, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
      exact takeWhile_eraseIdx P (b :: l) n fun i j hij hP => by
        simpa using h i.succ j.succ (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hP)
    · simp [hPa]

name: dropWile_eraseIdx
statement:
lemma dropWile_eraseIdx {I : Type} (P : I → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    (l : List I) → (i : ℕ) → (hi : ∀ (i j : Fin l.length), i < j → P (l.get j) → P (l.get i)) →
    List.dropWhile P (List.eraseIdx l i) =
      if (List.takeWhile P l).length ≤ i then
        (List.dropWhile P l).eraseIdx (i - (List.takeWhile P l).length)
      else (List.dropWhile P l)
  | [], _, h => by
    simp
  | a :: [], 0, h => by
    by_cases hPa : P a <;> simp [hPa]
  | a :: [], Nat.succ n, h => by
    by_cases hPa : P a <;> simp [hPa, List.eraseIdx_of_length_le]
  | a :: b :: l, 0, h => by
    by_cases hPb : P b
    · have hPa : P a
proof:
:= by
        simpa using h ⟨0, by simp⟩ ⟨1, by simp⟩ (by simp) (by simpa using hPb)
      simp [hPb, hPa]
    · by_cases hPa : P a <;> simp [hPa, hPb]
  | a :: b :: l, Nat.succ n, h => by
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]
    by_cases hPb : P b
    · have hPa : P a := by
        simpa using h ⟨0, by simp⟩ ⟨1, by simp⟩ (by simp) (by simpa using hPb)
      simp only [List.dropWhile, hPa, decide_true, List.takeWhile, hPb, List.length_cons,
        add_le_add_iff_right, Nat.reduceSubDiff]
      rw [dropWile_eraseIdx P (b :: l) n (fun i j hij hP => by
        simpa using h i.succ j.succ (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hP))]
      simp_all only [List.length_cons, List.get_eq_getElem, decide_true, List.takeWhile_cons_of_pos,
        List.dropWhile_cons_of_pos]
    · simp only [List.dropWhile, List.takeWhile, hPb, decide_false]
      by_cases hPa : P a
      · rw [dropWile_eraseIdx P (b :: l) n (fun i j hij hP => by
          simpa using h i.succ j.succ (by simpa using hij) (by simpa using hP))]
        simp only [hPa, decide_true, hPb, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true,
          List.takeWhile_cons_of_neg, List.length_nil, zero_le, ↓reduceIte, List.dropWhile,
          tsub_zero, List.length_singleton, le_add_iff_nonneg_left, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      · simp [hPa]

name: orderedInsertPos_sigma
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_sigma {I : Type} {f : I → Type}
    (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (l : List (Σ i, f i))
    (k : I) (a : f k) :
    (orderedInsertPos (fun (i j : Σ i, f i) => le1 i.1 j.1) l ⟨k, a⟩).1 =
    (orderedInsertPos le1 (List.map (fun (i : Σ i, f i) => i.1) l) k).1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not]
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.takeWhile]
    obtain ⟨fst, snd⟩ := a
    simp_all only
    split <;> simp_all

name: orderedInsert_get_lt
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_get_lt {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r)[i] = r.get ⟨i, by
      simp only [orderedInsertPos] at hi
      have h1 : (List.takeWhile (fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b) r).length ≤ r.length
proof:
:=
        List.Sublist.length_le (List.takeWhile_sublist fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b)
      omega⟩ := by
  simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not] at hi
  simp only [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop, decide_not, List.get_eq_getElem]
  rw [List.getElem_append]
  simp only [hi, ↓reduceDIte]
  rw [List.IsPrefix.getElem]
  exact List.takeWhile_prefix fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)

name: orderedInsertPos_take_orderedInsert
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_take_orderedInsert {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    (List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r)) =
    List.takeWhile (fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b) r
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedInsertPos, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]

name: orderedInsertPos_take_eq_orderedInsert
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_take_eq_orderedInsert {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r =
    List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r)
proof:
:= by
  refine List.ext_get ?_ ?_
  · simp only [List.length_take, Fin.is_le', inf_of_le_left, inf_eq_left]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0)
  · intro n h1 h2
    simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_take]
    rw [orderedInsert_get_lt le1 r r0 n]
    rfl
    simp only [List.length_take, lt_inf_iff] at h1
    exact h1.1

name: orderedInsertPos_drop_eq_orderedInsert
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_drop_eq_orderedInsert {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    List.drop (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r =
    List.drop (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).succ (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => simp [orderedInsertPos, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
  have hr : r = List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r ++
      List.dropWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r := by
    exact Eq.symm (List.takeWhile_append_dropWhile)
  conv_lhs =>
    rhs
    rw [hr]
  rw [List.drop_append]
  simp [orderedInsertPos]

name: orderedInsertPos_take
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_take {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r = List.takeWhile (fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedInsertPos_take_eq_orderedInsert,orderedInsertPos_take_orderedInsert]

name: orderedInsertPos_drop
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_drop {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    List.drop (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r = List.dropWhile (fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedInsertPos_drop_eq_orderedInsert]
  simp [orderedInsertPos, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]

name: orderedInsertPos_succ_take_orderedInsert
statement:
lemma orderedInsertPos_succ_take_orderedInsert {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    (List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).succ (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r)) =
    List.takeWhile (fun b => decide ¬le1 r0 b) r ++ [r0]
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedInsertPos, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop, List.take_append]

name: lt_orderedInsertPos_rel
statement:
lemma lt_orderedInsertPos_rel {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r0 : I) (r : List I) (n : Fin r.length)
    (hn : n.val < (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).val) : ¬ le1 r0 (r.get n)
proof:
:= by
  have htake : r.get n ∈ List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r := by
    rw [@List.mem_take_iff_getElem]
    use n
    simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem, lt_inf_iff, Fin.is_lt, and_true, exists_prop] using hn
  rw [orderedInsertPos_take] at htake
  simpa using List.mem_takeWhile_imp htake

name: lt_orderedInsertPos_rel_fin
statement:
lemma lt_orderedInsertPos_rel_fin {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r0 : I) (r : List I) (n : Fin (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).length)
    (hn : n < (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)) : ¬ le1 r0 ((List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).get n)
proof:
:= by
  have htake : (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).get n ∈ List.take (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) r := by
    rw [orderedInsertPos_take_eq_orderedInsert, List.mem_take_iff_getElem]
    use n
    simpa only [List.get_eq_getElem, Fin.is_le', inf_of_le_left, Fin.val_fin_lt, exists_prop,
      and_true] using hn
  rw [orderedInsertPos_take] at htake
  simpa using List.mem_takeWhile_imp htake

name: gt_orderedInsertPos_rel
statement:
lemma gt_orderedInsertPos_rel {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    [Std.Total le1] [IsTrans I le1] (r0 : I) (r : List I) (hs : List.Pairwise le1 r)
    (n : Fin r.length)
    (hn : ¬ n.val < (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).val) : le1 r0 (r.get n)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Pairwise.rel_of_mem_take_of_mem_drop (i := (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).succ)
    (List.Pairwise.orderedInsert r0 r hs)
  · rw [orderedInsertPos_succ_take_orderedInsert]
    simp
  · rw [← orderedInsertPos_drop_eq_orderedInsert]
    refine List.mem_drop_iff_getElem.mpr ?_
    use n - (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).val
    have hn : ↑n - ↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) + ↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0) < r.length := by
      omega
    use hn
    congr
    omega

name: orderedInsert_eraseIdx_lt_orderedInsertPos
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_lt_orderedInsertPos {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i < orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)
    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).eraseIdx i = List.orderedInsert le1 r0 (r.eraseIdx i)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => simp only [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
  rw [List.eraseIdx_append_of_lt_length]
  · simp only [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
    congr 1
    · rw [takeWhile_eraseIdx]
      exact hr
    · rw [dropWile_eraseIdx]
      simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not] at hi
      have hi' : ¬ (List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length ≤ ↑i := by omega
      simp only [decide_not, hi', ↓reduceIte]
      exact fun i j a a_1 => hr i j a a_1
  · exact hi

name: orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertPos_le
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertPos_le {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : orderedInsertPos le1 r r0 ≤ i)
    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).eraseIdx (Nat.succ i) =
    List.orderedInsert le1 r0 (r.eraseIdx i)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => simp only [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
  rw [List.eraseIdx_append_of_length_le]
  · simp only [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
    congr 1
    · rw [takeWhile_eraseIdx, List.eraseIdx_of_length_le]
      simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not] at hi
      simp only [decide_not]
      omega
      exact hr
    · simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
      have hn : (i + 1 - (List.takeWhile (fun b => (decide (¬ le1 r0 b))) r).length)
        = (i - (List.takeWhile (fun b => decide (¬ le1 r0 b)) r).length) + 1 := by
        simp only [orderedInsertPos] at hi
        omega
      rw [hn]
      simp only [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ, List.cons.injEq, true_and]
      rw [dropWile_eraseIdx, if_pos]
      · rw [orderedInsertPos] at hi
        omega
      · exact hr
  · simp only [orderedInsertPos] at hi
    omega

name: orderedInsertEquiv_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_zero {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) : orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 0 = orderedInsertPos le1 r r0
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedInsertEquiv]

name: orderedInsertEquiv_succ
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_succ {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n : ℕ) (hn : Nat.succ n < (r0 :: r).length) :
    orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 ⟨Nat.succ n, hn⟩ =
    Fin.cast (List.orderedInsert_length le1 r r0).symm
    ((Fin.succAbove ⟨(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0), orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0⟩)
    ⟨n, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hn⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.length_cons, orderedInsertEquiv, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Equiv.trans_apply]
  match r with
  | [] =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hn
    omega
  | r1 :: r =>
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    rw [finExtractOne_apply_neq]
    simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
      finExtractOne_symm_inr_apply]
    rfl
    exact ne_of_beq_false rfl

name: orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n : Fin r.length) :
    orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 n.succ = Fin.cast (List.orderedInsert_length le1 r r0).symm
    ((Fin.succAbove ⟨(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0), orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0⟩)
      ⟨n, n.isLt⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedInsertEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  match r with
  | [] =>
    exact n.elim0
  | r1 :: r =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.eta]
    rw [finExtractOne_apply_neq]
    simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
      finExtractOne_symm_inr_apply]
    rfl
    exact ne_of_beq_false rfl

name: orderedInsertEquiv_monotone_fin_succ
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_monotone_fin_succ {I : Type}
    (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) (n m : Fin r.length)
    (hx : orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 n.succ < orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 m.succ) :
    n < m
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ, orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ, Fin.lt_def] at hx
  simp only [Fin.eta, Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_fin_lt] at hx
  rwa [Fin.succAbove_lt_succAbove_iff] at hx

name: orderedInsertEquiv_congr
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_congr {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (a : α)
    (l l' : List α) (h : l = l') :
    orderedInsertEquiv r l a = (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv.trans
    ((orderedInsertEquiv r l' a).trans (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: get_eq_orderedInsertEquiv
statement:
lemma get_eq_orderedInsertEquiv {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) :
    (r0 :: r).get = (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).get ∘ (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  match x with
  | ⟨0, h⟩ =>
    simp
  | ⟨Nat.succ n, h⟩ =>
    simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_cons_succ,
      Function.comp_apply]
    rw [orderedInsertEquiv_succ]
    simp only [Fin.succAbove, Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Fin.succ_mk, Fin.val_cast]
    by_cases hn : n < ↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)
    · simp [hn, orderedInsert_get_lt]
    · simp only [hn, ↓reduceIte, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop, decide_not]
      rw [List.getElem_append]
      have hn' : ¬ n + 1 < (List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length := by
        simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not, not_lt] at hn
        omega
      simp only [hn', ↓reduceDIte]
      have hnn : n + 1 - (List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length =
        (n - (List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length) + 1 := by
        simp only [orderedInsertPos, decide_not, not_lt] at hn
        omega
      simp only [hnn, List.getElem_cons_succ]
      conv_rhs =>
        rw [List.IsSuffix.getElem (List.dropWhile_suffix fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b))]
      congr
      have hr : r.length = (List.takeWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length +
          (List.dropWhile (fun b => !decide (le1 r0 b)) r).length := by
        rw [← List.length_append]
        congr
        exact Eq.symm (List.takeWhile_append_dropWhile)
      simp only [hr, add_tsub_cancel_right]
      omega

name: orderedInsertEquiv_get
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_get {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I)
    (r0 : I) :
    (r0 :: r).get ∘ (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0).symm = (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).get
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [get_eq_orderedInsertEquiv le1]

name: orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_zero
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_zero
    {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).eraseIdx (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 ⟨0, by simp⟩) = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderedInsertEquiv]

name: orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_succ
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_succ
    {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I) (r0 : I) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : Nat.succ n < (r0 :: r).length)
    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).eraseIdx (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 ⟨Nat.succ n, hn⟩) =
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 (r.eraseIdx n))
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | nil =>
    simp at hn
  | cons r1 r ih =>
    rw [orderedInsertEquiv_succ]
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.succAbove,
      Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Fin.succ_mk, Fin.val_cast]
    by_cases hn' : n < (orderedInsertPos le1 (r1 :: r) r0)
    · simp only [hn', ↓reduceIte]
      rw [orderedInsert_eraseIdx_lt_orderedInsertPos le1 (r1 :: r) r0 n hn' hr]
    · simp only [hn', ↓reduceIte]
      rw [orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertPos_le le1 (r1 :: r) r0 n _ hr]
      omega

name: orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ
    {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (r : List I) (r0 : I) (n : Fin r.length)
    (hr : ∀ (i j : Fin r.length), i < j → ¬le1 r0 (r.get j) → ¬le1 r0 (r.get i)) :
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r).eraseIdx (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0 n.succ) =
    (List.orderedInsert le1 r0 (r.eraseIdx n))
proof:
:= by
  exact orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_succ le1 r r0 n.val (Nat.succ_lt_succ n.isLt) hr

name: orderedInsertEquiv_sigma
statement:
lemma orderedInsertEquiv_sigma {I : Type} {f : I → Type}
    (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1] (l : List (Σ i, f i))
    (i : I) (a : f i) :
    (orderedInsertEquiv (fun i j => le1 i.fst j.fst) l ⟨i, a⟩) =
    (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp)).toEquiv.trans
    ((orderedInsertEquiv le1 (List.map (fun i => i.1) l) i).trans
    (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [List.orderedInsert_length])).toEquiv)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  match x with
  | ⟨0, h0⟩ =>
    simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Equiv.trans_apply, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv, Fin.castOrderIso_apply,
      Fin.cast_zero, Fin.val_cast]
    rw [orderedInsertEquiv_zero, orderedInsertEquiv_zero]
    simp [orderedInsertPos_sigma]
  | ⟨Nat.succ n, h0⟩ =>
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Equiv.trans_apply, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv,
      Fin.castOrderIso_apply, Fin.cast_mk, Fin.val_cast]
    erw [orderedInsertEquiv_succ, orderedInsertEquiv_succ]
    simp only [orderedInsertPos_sigma, Fin.val_cast]
    rw [Fin.succAbove, Fin.succAbove]
    simp only [Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Fin.succ_mk]
    split <;> rfl

name: orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_orderedInsertPos
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_eq_insertIdx_orderedInsertPos {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    (r : List I) (r0 : I) :
    List.orderedInsert le1 r0 r = List.insertIdx r (orderedInsertPos le1 r r0).1 r0
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_get
  · simp only [List.orderedInsert_length]
    rw [List.length_insertIdx]
    exact (if_pos (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ (orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0))).symm
  intro n h1 h2
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := (orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0).surjective ⟨n, h1⟩
  rw [← hn']
  have hn'' : n = ((orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0) n').val := by rw [hn']
  subst hn''
  rw [← orderedInsertEquiv_get]
  simp only [List.length_cons, Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, List.get_eq_getElem]
  match n' with
  | ⟨0, h0⟩ =>
    simp only [List.getElem_cons_zero, Fin.zero_eta, orderedInsertEquiv_zero,
      List.getElem_insertIdx_self]
  | ⟨Nat.succ n', h0⟩ =>
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, List.getElem_cons_succ]
    have hr := orderedInsertEquiv_succ le1 r r0 n' h0
    trans (List.insertIdx r (↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)) r0).get
      ⟨↑((orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0) ⟨n' +1, h0⟩), h2⟩
    swap
    · rfl
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at hr
    have hx : (⟨↑((orderedInsertEquiv le1 r r0) ⟨n' +1, h0⟩), h2⟩ :
        Fin (List.insertIdx r (↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)) r0).length) =
      ⟨((⟨↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0),
      orderedInsertPos_lt_length le1 r r0⟩ : Fin ((r).length + 1))).succAbove
      ⟨n', Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h0⟩, by
          erw [← hr]
          exact h2⟩ := by
      rw [Fin.ext_iff]
      simp only
      simpa using hr
    rw [hx]
    simp only [Fin.succAbove, Fin.castSucc_mk, Fin.mk_lt_mk, Fin.succ_mk, List.get_eq_getElem]
    by_cases hn' : n' < ↑(orderedInsertPos le1 r r0)
    · simp only [hn', ↓reduceIte]
      erw [List.getElem_insertIdx_of_lt]
      exact hn'
    · simp only [hn', ↓reduceIte]
      rw [List.getElem_insertIdx_of_gt]
      · rfl
      · omega

name: insertionSortEquiv_get
statement:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_get {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] : (l : List α) →
    l.get ∘ (insertionSortEquiv r l).symm = (List.insertionSort r l).get
  | [] => by rfl
  | a :: l => by
    rw [insertionSortEquiv]
    change ((a :: l).get ∘ ((Fin.equivCons (insertionSortEquiv r l))).symm) ∘
      (orderedInsertEquiv r (List.insertionSort r l) a).symm = _
    have hl : (a :: l).get ∘ ((Fin.equivCons (insertionSortEquiv r l))).symm =
        (a :: List.insertionSort r l).get
proof:
:= by
      ext x
      match x with
      | ⟨0, h⟩ => rfl
      | ⟨Nat.succ x, h⟩ =>
        change _ = (List.insertionSort r l).get _
        rw [← insertionSortEquiv_get (r := r) l]
        rfl
    rw [hl, orderedInsertEquiv_get r (List.insertionSort r l) a]
    rfl

name: insertionSortEquiv_congr
statement:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_congr {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (l l' : List α)
    (h : l = l') : insertionSortEquiv r l = (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv.trans
      ((insertionSortEquiv r l').trans (Fin.castOrderIso (by simp [h])).toEquiv)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: insertionSortEquiv_congr_apply
statement:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_congr_apply {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (l l' : List α)
    (h : l = l') (i : Fin l.length) :
    insertionSortEquiv r l i =
    Fin.cast (by simp [h])
    ((insertionSortEquiv r l') (Fin.cast (by simp [h]) i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertionSortEquiv_congr l l' h]
  simp

name: insertionSort_get_comp_insertionSortEquiv
statement:
lemma insertionSort_get_comp_insertionSortEquiv {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r]
    (l : List α) : (List.insertionSort r l).get ∘ (insertionSortEquiv r l) = l.get
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [← insertionSortEquiv_get]

name: insertionSort_eq_ofFn
statement:
lemma insertionSort_eq_ofFn {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] (l : List α) :
    List.insertionSort r l = List.ofFn (l.get ∘ (insertionSortEquiv r l).symm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertionSortEquiv_get (r := r), List.ofFn_get]

name: insertionSortEquiv_order
statement:
lemma insertionSortEquiv_order {α : Type} {r : α → α → Prop} [DecidableRel r] :
    (l : List α) → (i : Fin l.length) → (j : Fin l.length) → (hij : i < j)
    → (hij' : insertionSortEquiv r l j < insertionSortEquiv r l i) →
    ¬ r l[i] l[j]
  | [], i, _, _, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | a :: as, ⟨0, hi⟩, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, hij, hij' => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.getElem_fin, Fin.val_zero,
      List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ]
    nth_rewrite 2 [insertionSortEquiv] at hij'
    simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.zero_eta] at hij'
    convert lt_orderedInsertPos_rel_fin r a (List.insertionSort r as) _ hij'
    change _ = ((List.insertionSort r (a :: as))).get ((insertionSortEquiv r (a :: as)) ⟨j + 1, hj⟩)
    rw [← insertionSortEquiv_get]
    simp
  | a :: as, ⟨i + 1, hi⟩, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, hij, hij' => by
    simp only [List.length_cons, insertionSortEquiv, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hij'
    simpa using insertionSortEquiv_order as ⟨i, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi⟩
      ⟨j, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hj⟩ (by simpa using hij)
      (orderedInsertEquiv_monotone_fin_succ _ _ _ _ _ hij')

/
  the list with the `i`'th element erased. -/
@[expose] def optionErase {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Option (Fin l.length)) : List I
proof:
:=
  match i with
  | none => l
  | some i => List.eraseIdx l i

name: eraseIdx_length'
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_length' {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).length = l.length - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.length_eraseIdx]

name: eraseIdx_length
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_length {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).length + 1 = l.length
proof:
:=
  List.length_eraseIdx_add_one i.isLt

name: eraseIdx_length_succ
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_length_succ {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).length.succ = l.length
proof:
:=
  List.length_eraseIdx_add_one i.isLt

name: eraseIdx_cons_length
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_cons_length {I : Type} (a : I) (l : List I) (i : Fin (a :: l).length) :
    (List.eraseIdx (a :: l) i).length= l.length
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.length_eraseIdx]

name: eraseIdx_get
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_get {I : Type} (l : List I) (i : Fin l.length) :
    (List.eraseIdx l i).get = l.get ∘ (Fin.cast (eraseIdx_length l i)) ∘
    (Fin.cast (eraseIdx_length l i).symm i).succAbove
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_eraseIdx]
  simp only [Fin.succAbove, Fin.val_cast]
  by_cases hi: x.castSucc < Fin.cast (Eq.symm (eraseIdx_length l i)) i
  · simp only [hi, ↓reduceIte, Fin.val_castSucc, dite_eq_left_iff, not_lt]
    intro h
    rw [Fin.lt_def] at hi
    simp_all only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_cast]
    omega
  · simp only [hi, ↓reduceIte, Fin.val_succ]
    rw [Fin.lt_def] at hi
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_cast, not_lt] at hi
    have hn : ¬ x.val < i.val := by omega
    simp [hn]

name: eraseIdx_insertionSort
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_insertionSort {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    [Std.Total le1] [IsTrans I le1] :
    (n : ℕ) → (r : List I) → (hn : n < r.length) →
    (List.insertionSort le1 r).eraseIdx ↑((insertionSortEquiv le1 r) ⟨n, hn⟩)
    = List.insertionSort le1 (r.eraseIdx n)
  | 0, [], _ => by rfl
  | 0, (r0 :: r), hn => by
    simp only [List.insertionSort, List.foldr_cons, List.length_cons, insertionSortEquiv,
      Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.zero_eta, Equiv.trans_apply, equivCons_zero, orderedInsertEquiv_zero,
      orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertPos, List.eraseIdx_zero, List.tail_cons]
  | Nat.succ n, [], hn => by rfl
  | Nat.succ n, (r0 :: r), hn => by
    simp only [List.insertionSort, List.length_cons, insertionSortEquiv, Nat.succ_eq_add_one,
      Equiv.trans_apply, equivCons_succ]
    have hOr
proof:
:= orderedInsert_eraseIdx_orderedInsertEquiv_fin_succ le1
      (List.insertionSort le1 r) r0 ((insertionSortEquiv le1 r) ⟨n, by simpa using hn⟩)
    erw [hOr]
    congr
    refine eraseIdx_insertionSort le1 n r _
    intro i j hij hn
    have hx := List.Pairwise.rel_get_of_lt (R := le1) (l := (List.insertionSort le1 r))
      (List.pairwise_insertionSort le1 r) hij
    have ht (i j k : I) (hij : le1 i j) (hjk : ¬ le1 k j) : ¬ le1 k i :=
      fun hik => hjk (IsTrans.trans (r := le1) k i j hik hij)
    exact ht ((List.insertionSort le1 r).get i) ((List.insertionSort le1 r).get j) r0 hx hn

name: eraseIdx_insertionSort_fin
statement:
lemma eraseIdx_insertionSort_fin {I : Type} (le1 : I → I → Prop) [DecidableRel le1]
    [Std.Total le1] [IsTrans I le1] (r : List I) (n : Fin r.length) :
    (List.insertionSort le1 r).eraseIdx ↑((Physlib.List.insertionSortEquiv le1 r) n)
    = List.insertionSort le1 (r.eraseIdx n)
proof:
:=
  eraseIdx_insertionSort le1 n.val r (Fin.prop n)

name: insertionSortMin_eq_insertionSort_head
statement:
lemma insertionSortMin_eq_insertionSort_head {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    (i : α) (l : List α) :
    insertionSortMin r i l = (List.insertionSort r (i :: l)).head (by
    refine List.ne_nil_of_length_pos ?_
    rw [insertionSort_length]
    exact Nat.zero_lt_succ l.length)
proof:
:= by
  trans (List.insertionSort r (i :: l)).get (⟨0, by
    rw [insertionSort_length]; exact Nat.zero_lt_succ l.length⟩)
  · rw [← insertionSortEquiv_get]
    rfl
  · exact List.get_mk_zero _

name: insertionSort_eq_insertionSortMin_cons
statement:
lemma insertionSort_eq_insertionSortMin_cons {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) [DecidableRel r]
    [Std.Total r] [IsTrans α r] (i : α) (l : List α) :
    List.insertionSort r (i :: l) =
    (insertionSortMin r i l) :: List.insertionSort r (insertionSortDropMinPos r i l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertionSortDropMinPos, ← eraseIdx_insertionSort_fin]
  conv_rhs =>
    rhs
    rhs
    rw [insertionSortMinPos, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp only [List.insertionSort, List.eraseIdx_zero]
  rw [insertionSortMin_eq_insertionSort_head]
  exact (List.cons_head_tail _).symm

name: optionEraseZ_some_length
statement:
@[simp]
lemma optionEraseZ_some_length {I : Type} (l : List I) (a : I) (i : (Fin l.length)) :
    (optionEraseZ l a (some i)).length = l.length - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [optionEraseZ, List.length_eraseIdx]

name: optionEraseZ_ext
statement:
lemma optionEraseZ_ext {I : Type} {l l' : List I} {a a' : I} {i : Option (Fin l.length)}
    {i' : Option (Fin l'.length)} (hl : l = l') (ha : a = a')
    (hi : Option.map (Fin.cast (by rw [hl])) i = i') :
    optionEraseZ l a i = optionEraseZ l' a' i'
proof:
:= by
  subst hl
  subst ha
  cases hi
  congr
  simp

name: mem_take_finrange
statement:
lemma mem_take_finrange : (n m : ℕ) → (a : Fin n) → a ∈ List.take m (List.finRange n) ↔ a.val < m
  | 0, m, a => Fin.elim0 a
  | n+1, 0, a => by
    simp
  | n +1, m + 1, ⟨0, h⟩ => by
    simp [List.finRange_succ]
  | n +1, m + 1, ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.finRange_succ, List.take_succ_cons, List.mem_cons, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero,
      AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, and_false, false_or, add_lt_add_iff_right]
    rw [← List.map_take, @List.mem_map]
    apply Iff.intro
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:= h
      rw [mem_take_finrange n m a, Fin.ext_iff] at ha
      simp_all only [Fin.val_succ, add_left_inj]
      omega
    · intro h1
      use ⟨i, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩
      simp only [Fin.succ_mk, and_true]
      rwa [mem_take_finrange n m ⟨i, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h⟩]

name: cross_cross_self_apply
statement:
lemma cross_cross_self_apply (v w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    (v ⨯₃ (w ⨯₃ v)) i = (∑ k, (v k) ^ 2) * w i - (∑ j, v j * w j) * v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [cross_cross_eq_smul_sub_smul']
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

name: dotProduct_cross_cross_self
statement:
lemma dotProduct_cross_cross_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (v w : Fin 3 → R) :
    w ⬝ᵥ (v ⨯₃ (w ⨯₃ v)) = (w ⨯₃ v) ⬝ᵥ (w ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [triple_product_permutation, triple_product_permutation]

name: contDiff_cross_dotProduct_cross
statement:
lemma contDiff_cross_dotProduct_cross (ω : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ⊤ fun v : Fin 3 → ℝ => (ω ⨯₃ v) ⬝ᵥ (ω ⨯₃ v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, cross_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
  fun_prop

name: prod
statement:
@[to_fun (attr := fun_prop)]
lemma prod {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedCommRing F] [NormedAlgebra ℝ F] {f : ι → E → F}
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, HasTemperateGrowth (f i)) : HasTemperateGrowth (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact const _
  | insert j t hjt ih =>
    simp_rw [insert_eq, prod_union (disjoint_singleton_left.mpr hjt), prod_singleton]
    exact fun_mul (hf j <| mem_insert_self j t) (ih fun i h ↦ hf i <| mem_insert_of_mem h)

name: _root_.Basis.conj_repr_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma _root_.Basis.conj_repr_apply (b : Basis ι k M) (v : ConjModule M) (i : ι) :
    (Basis.conj b).repr v i = star (b.repr ((conjEquiv (k := k) (M := M)).symm v) i)
proof: := rfl

name: _root_.Basis.conj_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma _root_.Basis.conj_apply (b : Basis ι k M) (i : ι) :
    Basis.conj b i = conjEquiv (k := k) (M := M) (b i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Basis.conj b).repr.injective
  ext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with h | h
  · subst h; simp [Basis.conj_repr_apply]
  · simp [Basis.conj_repr_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne, h]

name: dotProduct_mulVec_orthogonal
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_orthogonal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n R} (hA : Aᵀ * A = 1) (v w : n → R) :
    (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) = v ⬝ᵥ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, mulVec_mulVec, hA, one_mulVec]

name: fderiv_uncurry
statement:
lemma fderiv_uncurry (f : X → Y → Z) (xy dxy : X × Y)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (↿f) xy) :
    fderiv 𝕜 ↿f xy dxy
    =
    fderiv 𝕜 (f · xy.2) xy.1 dxy.1 + fderiv 𝕜 (f xy.1 ·) xy.2 dxy.2
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (f · xy.2) = ↿f ∘ (fun x' => (x',xy.2)) := by rfl
  have hy : (f xy.1 ·) = ↿f ∘ (fun y' => (xy.1,y')) := by rfl
  rw [hx,hy]
  repeat rw [fderiv_comp (hg := by fun_prop) (hf := by fun_prop)]
  dsimp
  rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.map_add]
  congr
  repeat rw [DifferentiableAt.fderiv_prodMk (hf₁ := by fun_prop) (hf₂ := by fun_prop)]
  simp

name: fderiv_curry_fst
statement:
lemma fderiv_curry_fst (f : X × Y → Z) (x : X) (y : Y)
    (h : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f (x,y)) (dx : X) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => Function.curry f x' y) x dx = fderiv 𝕜 f (x,y) (dx, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : f = ↿(Function.curry f) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [h1]
  rw [fderiv_uncurry]
  simp only [Function.curry_apply, map_zero, add_zero]
  exact h

name: fderiv_curry_snd
statement:
lemma fderiv_curry_snd (f : X × Y → Z) (x : X) (y : Y)
    (h : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f (x,y)) (dy : Y) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (Function.curry f x) y dy = fderiv 𝕜 (f) (x,y) (0, dy)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : f = ↿(Function.curry f) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [h1]
  rw [fderiv_uncurry]
  simp
  rfl
  exact h

name: fderiv_uncurry_clm_comp
statement:
lemma fderiv_uncurry_clm_comp (f : X → Y → Z) (hf : Differentiable 𝕜 (↿f)) :
    fderiv 𝕜 ↿f
    =
    fun xy =>
      (fderiv 𝕜 (f · xy.2) xy.1).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst 𝕜 X Y)
      +
      (fderiv 𝕜 (f xy.1 ·) xy.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd 𝕜 X Y)
proof:
:= by
  funext xy
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro dxy
  rw [fderiv_uncurry]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_wrt_prod
statement:
lemma fderiv_wrt_prod {f : X × Y → Z} {xy} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f xy) :
    fderiv 𝕜 f xy
    =
    (fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => f (x',xy.2)) xy.1).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst 𝕜 X Y)
    +
    (fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => f (xy.1,y')) xy.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd 𝕜 X Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext; intro (dx,dy)
  apply fderiv_uncurry (fun x y => f (x,y)) _ _ hf

name: fderiv_wrt_prod_clm_comp
statement:
lemma fderiv_wrt_prod_clm_comp (f : X × Y → Z) (hf : Differentiable 𝕜 f) :
    fderiv 𝕜 f
    =
    fun xy =>
      (fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => f (x',xy.2)) xy.1).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst 𝕜 X Y)
      +
      (fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => f (xy.1,y')) xy.2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd 𝕜 X Y)
proof:
:=
  fderiv_uncurry_clm_comp (fun x y => f (x,y)) hf

name: fderiv_curry_clm_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_curry_clm_apply (f : X → Y →L[𝕜] Z) (y : Y) (x dx : X) (h : Differentiable 𝕜 f) :
    fderiv 𝕜 f x dx y
    =
    fderiv 𝕜 (f · y) x dx

name: fderiv_uncurry_comp_fst
statement:
lemma fderiv_uncurry_comp_fst (f : X → Y → Z) (y : Y) (hf : Differentiable 𝕜 (↿f)) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => (↿f) (x', y))
    =
    fun x => (fderiv 𝕜 (↿f) ((·, y) x)).comp (fderiv 𝕜 (·, y) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hl (y : Y) : (fun x' => (↿f) (x', y)) = ↿f ∘ (·, y) := by
    rfl

@[fun_prop]
lemma fderiv_uncurry_differentiable_fst_comp_snd_apply (f : X → Y → Z) (x δx : X)
    (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    Differentiable 𝕜 (fun y' => fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => (↿f) (x', y')) x δx)
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_uncurry_differentiable_snd_comp_fst
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma fderiv_uncurry_differentiable_snd_comp_fst (f : X → Y → Z) (y : Y) (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    Differentiable 𝕜 (fun x' => fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => (↿f) (x', y')) y)
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_uncurry_differentiable_snd_comp_fst_apply
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma fderiv_uncurry_differentiable_snd_comp_fst_apply (f : X → Y → Z) (y δy : Y)
    (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    Differentiable 𝕜 (fun x' => fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => (↿f) (x', y')) y δy)
proof:
:= by
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_curry_differentiableAt_fst_comp_snd
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma fderiv_curry_differentiableAt_fst_comp_snd (f : X → Y → Z) (x dx : X) (y : Y)
    (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (fun y' => (fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => f x' y') x) dx) y
proof:
:= by
  apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_curry_differentiableAt_snd_comp_fst
statement:
lemma fderiv_curry_differentiableAt_snd_comp_fst (f : X → Y → Z) (x : X) (y dy : Y)
    (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (fun x' => (fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => f x' y') y) dy) x
proof:
:= by
  apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_swap
statement:
lemma fderiv_swap [IsRCLikeNormedField 𝕜] (f : X → Y → Z) (x dx : X) (y dy : Y)
    (hf : ContDiff 𝕜 2 ↿f) :
    fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => f x' y') y dy) x dx
    =
    fderiv 𝕜 (fun y' => fderiv 𝕜 (fun x' => f x' y') x dx) y dy
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : IsSymmSndFDerivAt 𝕜 (↿f) (x,y) := by
    apply ContDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (n := 2)
    · exact ContDiff.contDiffAt hf
    · simp
  have h := IsSymmSndFDerivAt.eq hf' (dx,0) (0,dy)
  rw [fderiv_wrt_prod_clm_comp, fderiv_wrt_prod_clm_comp] at h
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', map_zero,
    add_zero, zero_add] at h
  rw [fderiv_curry_clm_apply, fderiv_curry_clm_apply] at h
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst', Function.comp_apply, map_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
    zero_add, add_zero] at h
  exact h
  /- Start of differentiability conditions. -/
  · fun_prop
  · fun_prop
  · exact hf.differentiable (by simp)
  · fun_prop

name: sub_le_zero
statement: lemma sub_le_zero : f - f ≤ 0
proof: := ⟨le_top, by simp [sub_apply]⟩

name: neg_add_le_zero
statement: lemma neg_add_le_zero : -f + f ≤ 0
proof: := ⟨le_top, by simp [add_apply]⟩

name: le_iff_neg_le_neg
statement: lemma le_iff_neg_le_neg : g₁ ≤ g₂ ↔ -g₁ ≤ -g₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h, h'⟩ ↦ ⟨h, fun _ _ h'' ↦ by simp [h' h'']⟩, fun ⟨h, _⟩ ↦ ⟨h, fun _ _ _ ↦ by aesop⟩⟩

name: le_neg_iff_neg_le
statement: lemma le_neg_iff_neg_le : g₁ ≤ -g₂ ↔ -g₁ ≤ g₂
proof: := by rw [le_iff_neg_le_neg, neg_neg]

name: add_sub_le_cancel
statement: lemma add_sub_le_cancel : f₁ + (f₂ - f₁) ≤ f₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [add_domain, sub_domain], fun _ _ h ↦ by simp [add_apply, sub_apply, h]⟩

name: add_sub_le_cancel_left
statement: lemma add_sub_le_cancel_left : f₁ + f₂ - f₁ ≤ f₂
proof: := add_sub_assoc f₁ f₂ f₁ ▸ add_sub_le_cancel f₁ f₂

name: add_sub_le_cancel_right
statement: lemma add_sub_le_cancel_right : f₁ + f₂ - f₂ ≤ f₁
proof: := add_comm f₁ f₂ ▸ add_sub_le_cancel_left f₂ f₁

name: add_add_sub_le_cancel
statement: lemma add_add_sub_le_cancel : f₁ + f₂ + (f₃ - f₂) ≤ f₁ + f₃
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ ↦ by simp_all [add_domain, sub_domain], fun _ _ h ↦ by simp [add_apply, sub_apply, h]⟩

name: add_sub_sub_le_cancel
statement: lemma add_sub_sub_le_cancel : f₁ + f₂ - (f₁ - f₃) ≤ f₂ + f₃
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ ↦ by simp_all [add_domain, sub_domain], fun _ _ h ↦ by simp [add_apply, sub_apply, h]⟩

name: sub_sub_sub_le_cancel_right
statement: lemma sub_sub_sub_le_cancel_right : f₁ - f₂ - (f₃ - f₂) ≤ f₁ - f₃
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add]
  exact sub_eq_add_neg (-f₃) (-f₂) ▸ add_add_sub_le_cancel f₁ (-f₂) (-f₃)

name: sub_sub_sub_le_cancel_left
statement: lemma sub_sub_sub_le_cancel_left : f₁ - f₂ - (f₁ - f₃) ≤ f₃ - f₂
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_add_neg f₁ f₂ ▸ neg_add_eq_sub f₂ f₃ ▸ add_sub_sub_le_cancel f₁ (-f₂) f₃

name: sub_le_of_le_add
statement: lemma sub_le_of_le_add (h : g ≤ g₁ + g₂) : g - g₂ ≤ g₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (inf_le_of_left_le le_rfl).trans (le_inf_iff.mp <| add_domain g₁ g₂ ▸ h.1).1
  · intro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ rfl
    simp [sub_apply, @h.2 ⟨x, hx.1⟩ ⟨x, ⟨hy, hx.2⟩⟩ rfl, add_apply]

name: sub_add_le_cancel
statement: lemma sub_add_le_cancel : f₁ - f₂ + f₂ ≤ f₁
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_add_neg f₁ f₂ ▸ sub_neg_eq_add _ f₂ ▸ add_sub_le_cancel_right f₁ (-f₂)

name: add_le_of_le_sub
statement: lemma add_le_of_le_sub (h : g ≤ g₁ - g₂) : g + g₂ ≤ g₁
proof:
:=
  sub_neg_eq_add g g₂ ▸ sub_le_of_le_add (sub_eq_add_neg g₁ g₂ ▸ h)

name: add_left_le_of_le
statement: lemma add_left_le_of_le (h : g₁ ≤ g₂) : f + g₁ ≤ f + g₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [add_domain, le_inf_iff, inf_le_left, true_and]
    exact (inf_le_of_right_le le_rfl).trans h.1
  · intro x y hxy
    simp_rw [add_apply, @h.2 ⟨x, x.2.2⟩ ⟨y, y.2.2⟩ hxy, hxy]

name: add_right_le_of_le
statement: lemma add_right_le_of_le (h : g₁ ≤ g₂) : g₁ + f ≤ g₂ + f
proof:
:=
  add_comm f g₁ ▸ add_comm f g₂ ▸ add_left_le_of_le f h

name: sub_right_le_of_le
statement: lemma sub_right_le_of_le (h : g₁ ≤ g₂) : g₁ - f ≤ g₂ - f
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_add_neg g₁ f ▸ sub_eq_add_neg g₂ f ▸ add_right_le_of_le (-f) h

name: sub_left_le_of_le
statement: lemma sub_left_le_of_le (h : g₁ ≤ g₂) : f - g₁ ≤ f - g₂
proof:
:=
  neg_sub g₁ f ▸ neg_sub g₂ f ▸ le_iff_neg_le_neg.mp (sub_right_le_of_le f h)

name: zero_smul_le
statement: lemma zero_smul_le (f : E →ₗ.[𝕜] F) : (0 : 𝕜) • f ≤ 0
proof: := ⟨le_top, by simp⟩

name: zero_smul_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_smul_eq {f : E →ₗ.[𝕜] F} (h : f.domain = ⊤) : (0 : 𝕜) • f = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_of_le_of_domain_eq f.zero_smul_le h

name: sum_domain
statement: lemma sum_domain : (sum f).domain = ⨅ a, (f a).domain
proof: := rfl

name: sum_domain_le
statement: lemma sum_domain_le (a : α) : (sum f).domain ≤ (f a).domain
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ by simp_all [sum, mem_iInf]

name: sum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_apply (ψ : (sum f).domain) : sum f ψ = ∑ a, f a ⟨ψ, sum_domain_le f a ψ.2⟩
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.sum_apply Finset.univ (fun a ↦ (f a).toFun ∘ₗ inclusion (sum_domain_le f a)) ψ

name: compRestricted_domain_le
statement: lemma compRestricted_domain_le : (g ∘ᵣ f).domain ≤ f.domain
proof: := fun _ h ↦ h.2

name: compRestricted_domain
statement: lemma compRestricted_domain : (g ∘ᵣ f).domain = (g.domain.comap f.toFun).map f.domain.subtype
proof:
:= by
  change (f.domRestrict <| (g.domain.comap f.toFun).map f.domain.subtype).domain = _
  rw [domRestrict_domain]
  refine inf_of_le_left ?_
  intro x h
  simp only [mem_map, mem_comap, toFun_eq_coe, subtype_apply, Subtype.exists, exists_and_right,
    exists_eq_right] at h
  exact h.choose

name: mem_compRestricted_domain_iff
statement:
lemma mem_compRestricted_domain_iff {x : E} :
    x ∈ (v ∘ᵣ u).domain ↔ ∃ h : x ∈ u.domain, u ⟨x, h⟩ ∈ v.domain
proof:
:= by
  simp [compRestricted_domain]

name: mem_compRestricted_domain_iff'
statement:
lemma mem_compRestricted_domain_iff' {x : E} :
    x ∈ (v ∘ᵣ u).domain ↔ ∃ y : u.domain, x = y ∧ ∃ y' : v.domain, u y = y'
proof:
:= by
  simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff]

name: mem_domain_of_mem_compRestricted_domain
statement: lemma mem_domain_of_mem_compRestricted_domain (x : (v ∘ᵣ u).domain) : u ⟨x, x.2.2⟩ ∈ v.domain
proof:
:=
  (mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp x.2).choose_spec

name: compRestricted_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compRestricted_apply (x : (v ∘ᵣ u).domain) :
    (v ∘ᵣ u) x = v ⟨u ⟨x, x.2.2⟩, mem_domain_of_mem_compRestricted_domain x⟩
proof: := rfl

name: compRestricted_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compRestricted_zero : g ∘ᵣ (0 : E →ₗ.[R] F) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff]
  · exact g.map_zero

name: compRestricted_assoc
statement:
lemma compRestricted_assoc {H : Type*} [AddCommGroup H] [Module R H]
    (f₁ : G →ₗ.[R] H) (f₂ : F →ₗ.[R] G) (f₃ : E →ₗ.[R] F) :
    (f₁ ∘ᵣ f₂) ∘ᵣ f₃ = f₁ ∘ᵣ f₂ ∘ᵣ f₃
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp only [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff]
    tauto
  · rfl

name: compRestricted_eq_comp
statement:
lemma compRestricted_eq_comp (h : ∀ x : u.domain, u x ∈ v.domain) :
    v ∘ᵣ u = v.comp u h
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  · change _ ↔ x ∈ u.domain
    simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff, h]
  · rfl

name: comp_le_compRestricted
statement:
lemma comp_le_compRestricted
    {S : Submodule R E} (h : ∀ x : (u.domRestrict S).domain, u ⟨x, x.2.2⟩ ∈ v.domain) :
    v.comp (u.domRestrict S) h ≤ v ∘ᵣ u
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x hx ↦ mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mpr ⟨hx.2, h ⟨x, hx⟩⟩, by aesop⟩

name: compRestricted_mono_left
statement:
lemma compRestricted_mono_left {g g' : F →ₗ.[R] G} (h : g ≤ g') (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) :
    g ∘ᵣ f ≤ g' ∘ᵣ f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx', hfx⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp hx
    exact mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mpr ⟨hx', h.1 hfx⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    exact @h.2 ⟨f ⟨x, x.2.2⟩, mem_domain_of_mem_compRestricted_domain x⟩
      ⟨f ⟨y, y.2.2⟩, mem_domain_of_mem_compRestricted_domain y⟩ (by simp [hxy])

name: compRestricted_mono_right
statement:
lemma compRestricted_mono_right (g : F →ₗ.[R] G) {f f' : E →ₗ.[R] F} (h : f ≤ f') :
    g ∘ᵣ f ≤ g ∘ᵣ f'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx', hfx⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp hx
    exact mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mpr ⟨h.1 hx', (@h.2 ⟨x, hx'⟩ ⟨x, h.1 hx'⟩ rfl) ▸ hfx⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    simp only [compRestricted_apply, @h.2 ⟨x, x.2.2⟩ ⟨y, y.2.2⟩ hxy]

name: neg_compRestricted
statement:
@[simp]
lemma neg_compRestricted : (-g) ∘ᵣ f = -g ∘ᵣ f
proof: := rfl

name: compRestricted_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compRestricted_neg : g ∘ᵣ (-f) = -g ∘ᵣ f
proof:
:= by
  ext x hx hx'
  · simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff]
  · obtain ⟨h, h'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp (neg_domain (g ∘ᵣ f) ▸ hx')
    exact g.toFun.map_neg ⟨f ⟨x, h⟩, h'⟩

name: add_compRestricted
statement: lemma add_compRestricted : (g₁ + g₂) ∘ᵣ f = g₁ ∘ᵣ f + g₂ ∘ᵣ f
proof:
:= by
  ext x hx hx'
  · simp only [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff, add_domain, mem_inf]
    tauto
  · simp [add_apply]

name: sub_compRestricted
statement: lemma sub_compRestricted : (g₁ - g₂) ∘ᵣ f = g₁ ∘ᵣ f - g₂ ∘ᵣ f
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_compRestricted]

name: compRestricted_add_ge
statement: lemma compRestricted_add_ge : g ∘ᵣ f₁ + g ∘ᵣ f₂ ≤ g ∘ᵣ (f₁ + f₂)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₁'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp hx.1
    obtain ⟨h₂, h₂'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp hx.2
    exact mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mpr ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, add_mem h₁' h₂'⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₁'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp x.2.1
    obtain ⟨h₂, h₂'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp x.2.2
    simp [← hxy, add_apply, ← g.map_add ⟨f₁ ⟨x, h₁⟩, h₁'⟩ ⟨f₂ ⟨x, h₂⟩, h₂'⟩]

name: compRestricted_sub_ge
statement: lemma compRestricted_sub_ge : g ∘ᵣ f₁ - g ∘ᵣ f₂ ≤ g ∘ᵣ (f₁ - f₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, ← compRestricted_neg]
  exact compRestricted_add_ge g f₁ (-f₂)

name: compRestricted_smul
statement:
lemma compRestricted_smul {S : Type*} [DivisionRing S]
    [Module S E] [Module S F] [Module S G] [SMulCommClass S S F] [SMulCommClass S S G]
    {c : S} (hc : c ≠ 0) (g : F →ₗ.[S] G) (f : E →ₗ.[S] F) :
    g ∘ᵣ (c • f) = c • (g ∘ᵣ f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x hx hx'
  · simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff, g.domain.smul_mem_iff hc]
  · obtain ⟨h, h'⟩ := mem_compRestricted_domain_iff.mp (smul_domain c (g ∘ᵣ f) ▸ hx')
    exact g.toFun.map_smul c ⟨f ⟨x, h⟩, h'⟩

name: smul_compRestricted
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_compRestricted {M : Type*} [Monoid M] [DistribMulAction M G] [SMulCommClass R M G]
    (c : M) (g : F →ₗ.[R] G) (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) :
    (c • g) ∘ᵣ f = c • (g ∘ᵣ f)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [compRestricted_domain]
  · simp

name: mul_def
statement: lemma mul_def (f₁ f₂ : E →ₗ.[R] E) : f₁ * f₂ = f₁ ∘ᵣ f₂
proof: := rfl

name: one_domain
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_domain : (1 : E →ₗ.[R] E).domain = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: one_toFun
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_toFun : (1 : E →ₗ.[R] E).toFun = topEquiv.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: one_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_coe : (1 : E →ₗ.[R] E).toFun' = ⇑topEquiv.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: inverse_ker
statement: lemma inverse_ker : f.inverse.toFun.ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr fun ⟨y, hy⟩ hy' ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := inverse_domain (f := f) ▸ hy
  simp_all [inverse_apply_eq (x := x) (y := ⟨y, hy⟩) h_ker hx]

name: inverse_inverse
statement: lemma inverse_inverse : f.inverse.inverse = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x hx hx'
  · rw [inverse_domain, inverse_range h_ker]
  · refine inverse_apply_eq (y := ⟨x, hx⟩) (x := ⟨f ⟨x, hx'⟩, by simp [inverse_domain]⟩) ?_ ?_
    · exact inverse_ker h_ker
    · exact inverse_apply_eq (y := ⟨f ⟨x, hx'⟩, by simp [inverse_domain]⟩) (x := ⟨x, hx'⟩) h_ker rfl

name: inverse_compRestricted_eq
statement: lemma inverse_compRestricted_eq : f.inverse ∘ᵣ f = domRestrict 1 f.domain
proof:
:= by
  ext x hx hx'
  · simp [mem_compRestricted_domain_iff, inverse_domain, ← toFun_eq_coe]
  · exact inverse_apply_eq (x := ⟨x, hx.2⟩) h_ker rfl

name: compRestricted_inverse_eq
statement: lemma compRestricted_inverse_eq : f ∘ᵣ f.inverse = domRestrict 1 f.inverse.domain
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← inverse_inverse h_ker]
  exact inverse_compRestricted_eq (inverse_ker h_ker)

name: map_smul
statement: lemma map_smul (f : HomogeneousQuadratic V) (a : ℚ) (S : V) : f (a • S) = a ^ 2 * f S
proof:
:=
  f.map_smul' a S

name: map_smul
statement: lemma map_smul₁ (f : BiLinearSymm V) (a : ℚ) (S T : V) : f (a • S) T = a * f S T
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (a • S) = a • (f S) := by
    exact f.map_smul a S
  simp [h]

name: swap
statement: lemma swap (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S T : V) : f S T = f T S
proof: := f.swap' S T

name: map_smul
statement: lemma map_smul₂ (f : BiLinearSymm V) (a : ℚ) (S : V) (T : V) : f S (a • T) = a * f S T
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.swap, f.map_smul₁, f.swap]

name: map_add
statement: lemma map_add₁ (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S1 S2 T : V) : f (S1 + S2) T = f S1 T + f S2 T
proof:
:= by
  have h : f (S1 + S2) = f S1 + f S2 := by
    exact f.map_add S1 S2
  simp [h]

name: map_add
statement:
lemma map_add₂ (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S : V) (T1 T2 : V) :
    f S (T1 + T2) = f S T1 + f S T2
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.swap, f.map_add₁, f.swap T1 S, f.swap T2 S]

name: toLinear
statement: lemma toLinear₁_apply (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S T : V) : f S T = f.toLinear₁ T S
proof: := rfl

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₁ {n : ℕ} (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n → V) (T : V) :
    f (∑ i, S i) T = ∑ i, f (S i) T
proof:
:= by
  simp [f.toLinear₁_apply, map_sum]

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₂ {n : ℕ} (f : BiLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n → V) (T : V) :
    f T (∑ i, S i) = ∑ i, f T (S i)
proof: := map_sum (f T) S Finset.univ

name: toHomogeneousQuad_add
statement:
lemma toHomogeneousQuad_add {V : Type} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℚ V]
    (τ : BiLinearSymm V) (S T : V) :
    τ.toHomogeneousQuad (S + T) = τ.toHomogeneousQuad S +
    τ.toHomogeneousQuad T + 2 * τ S T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HomogeneousQuadratic, toHomogeneousQuad_apply, τ.map_add₁, map_add, τ.swap T S]
  grind

name: map_smul
statement: lemma map_smul (f : HomogeneousCubic V) (a : ℚ) (S : V) : f (a • S) = a ^ 3 * f S
proof:
:=
  f.map_smul' a S

name: swap
statement: lemma swap₁ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f T S L
proof:
:=
  f.swap₁' S T L

name: swap

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₁ {n : ℕ} (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n → V) (T : V) (L : V) :

proof:

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₂ {n : ℕ} (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n → V) (T : V) (L : V) :
    f T (∑ i, S i) L = ∑ i, f T (S i) L
proof:
:= by
  rw [swap₁, map_sum₁]
  refine Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun _ ↦ swap₁ f (S _) T L

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₃ {n : ℕ} (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n → V) (T : V) (L : V) :
    f T L (∑ i, S i) = ∑ i, f T L (S i)
proof: := map_sum ((f T) L) S Finset.univ

name: map_sum
statement:
lemma map_sum₁₂₃ {n1 n2 n3 : ℕ} (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S : Fin n1 → V)
    (T : Fin n2 → V) (L : Fin n3 → V) :
    f (∑ i, S i) (∑ i, T i) (∑ i, L i) = ∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ l, f (S i) (T k) (L l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum₁]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sum₂]
  exact Fintype.sum_congr _ _ fun _ ↦ map_sum₃ f L (S _) (T _)

name: toCubic_add
statement:
lemma toCubic_add {charges : Type} [AddCommMonoid charges] [Module ℚ charges]
    (τ : TriLinearSymm charges) (S T : charges) :
    τ.toCubic (S + T) = τ.toCubic S +
    τ.toCubic T + 3 * τ S S T + 3 * τ T T S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic, toCubic_apply]
  rw [τ.map_add₁, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃]
  rw [τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₁ T S S, τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₂ T S T, τ.swap₁ S T T, τ.swap₂ T S T]
  grind

name: mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero
statement: lemma mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : t ∈ resolventSet ℝ z
proof:

name: resolventSet_eq_univ

name: norm_resolvent_le
statement: lemma norm_resolvent_le (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : ‖resolvent z t‖ ≤ |z.im|⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [resolvent, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, norm_inv]
  exact inv_anti₀ (abs_pos.mpr hz) (by simpa using Complex.abs_im_le_norm ((algebraMap ℝ ℂ) t - z))

name: contDiff_resolvent
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma contDiff_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)
proof:
:= by
  have : resolvent (R := ℝ) z = fun t : ℝ ↦ ((t : ℂ) - z)⁻¹ := funext fun t ↦ Ring.inverse_eq_inv _
  rw [this]
  exact (Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.sub contDiff_const).inv fun t ↦
    (spectrum.mem_resolventSet_iff.mp (mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero hz t)).ne_zero

name: iteratedDeriv_resolvent
statement:
lemma iteratedDeriv_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)
      = fun t ↦ (-1) ^ n * (n ! : ℂ) * resolvent z t ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    funext t
    have hd := ((spectrum.hasDerivAt_resolvent_const_left
      (mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero hz t)).pow (n + 1)).const_mul ((-1) ^ n * (n ! : ℂ))
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply] at hd
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, hd.deriv]
    push_cast [Nat.factorial_succ]
    ring

name: norm_iteratedDeriv_resolvent_le
statement:
lemma norm_iteratedDeriv_resolvent_le (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n (resolvent z) t‖ ≤ n ! * (|z.im| ^ (n + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = n ! * ‖resolvent z t‖ ^ (n + 1) := by simp [iteratedDeriv_resolvent, hz]
    _ ≤ n ! * (|z.im| ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ := by
      rw [← inv_pow]
      gcongr
      exact norm_resolvent_le hz t

name: hasTemperateGrowth_resolvent
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma hasTemperateGrowth_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    Function.HasTemperateGrowth (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨contDiff_resolvent hz, fun n ↦ ⟨0, n ! * (|z.im| ^ (n + 1))⁻¹, fun t ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, pow_zero, mul_one]
  exact norm_iteratedDeriv_resolvent_le hz n t

name: finAddEquivSigmaCond_true
statement: lemma finAddEquivSigmaCond_true (h : i < m) : finAddEquivSigmaCond i = ⟨true, i, h⟩
proof:

name: finAddEquivSigmaCond_false
statement: lemma finAddEquivSigmaCond_false (h : ¬ i < m) : finAddEquivSigmaCond i = ⟨false, i.subNat' h⟩
proof:
:=
  let j : Fin n := i.subNat' h
  calc finAddEquivSigmaCond i
    _ = finAddEquivSigmaCond (Fin.natAdd m j) :=
      suffices m + (i - m) = i from congrArg _ (Fin.ext this.symm)
      Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
    _ = ⟨false, i.subNat' h⟩ := congrArg sumEquivSigmalCond <| finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd j

name: schur_triangulation
statement:
lemma schur_triangulation :
    A = A.schurTriangulationUnitary * A.schurTriangulation * star A.schurTriangulationUnitary
proof:
:=
  let U := A.schurTriangulationUnitary
  have h : U * A.schurTriangulation.val = A * U :=
    let b := A.schurTriangulationBasis.toBasis
    let c := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun n 𝕜).toBasis
    calc c.toMatrix b * LinearMap.toMatrix b b (toEuclideanLin A)
      _ = LinearMap.toMatrix c c (toEuclideanLin A) * c.toMatrix b := by simp
      _ = LinearMap.toMatrix c c (toLin c c A) * U := rfl
      _ = A * U := by simp
  calc A
    _ = A * U * star U := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = U * A.schurTriangulation * star U := by rw [← h]

statement:
lemma scaleUnit_measure (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure M) :
    scaleUnit u1 u2 μ = μ.map (fun m => scaleUnit u1 u2 m)
proof: := by rfl

name: integral_isDimensionallyCorrect
statement:
lemma integral_isDimensionallyCorrect (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    IsDimensionallyCorrect (fun (μ : DimSet (MeasureTheory.Measure M) d)
      (f : DimSet (M → G) (dim G * d⁻¹)) ↦ ∫ x, f.1 x ∂μ.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro u1 u2
  funext ⟨μ, hμ⟩ ⟨f, hf⟩
  /- We have to prove that
    `scaleUnit u1 (fun μ f ↦ ∫ x, f x ∂μ) u2 ⟨μ, hμ⟩ ⟨f, hf⟩ = ∫ x, f x ∂μ` -/
  calc _
    /- By definition the LHS is equal to
    `scaleUnit u1 u2 (∫ x, (scaleUnit u2 u1 f) x ∂(scaleUnit u2 u1 μ)) `
    The statement says, suppose `f` and `μ` are in units `u2`, we change them to units `u1`,
    then do the integral, and then we take the result back to `u2`.
    If the integral is dimensionally correct, this should be the same as just doing the
    original integral in `u2` units i.e. `∫ x, f x ∂μ`. -/
    _ = scaleUnit u1 u2 (∫ x, (scaleUnit u2 u1 f) x ∂(scaleUnit u2 u1 μ)) := by
      simp
    /- Since we have assumed `μ` has dimension `d`, `(scaleUnit u2 μ u1)`
      is equal to `(u2.dimScale u1 d) • μ` -/
    _ = scaleUnit u1 u2 (u2.dimScale u1 d • ∫ (x : M), scaleUnit u2 u1 f x ∂ μ) := by
      rw [hμ, integral_smul_nnreal_measure]
    /- Since we assumed `f` has dimension `CarriesDimension.d G * d⁻¹`, `(scaleUnit u2 f u1)`
      is equal to `u2.dimScale u1 (CarriesDimension.d G * d⁻¹) • f`. -/
    _ = scaleUnit u1 u2 (u2.dimScale u1 d •
      u2.dimScale u1 (dim G * d⁻¹) • ∫ (x : M), f x ∂ μ) := by
      rw [hf]
      congr
      erw [MeasureTheory.integral_smul]
      rfl
    /- What remains is a simple cancellation of the dimensional scales. -/
    _ = (u1.dimScale u2 (dim G)) • ((u2.dimScale u1 d) •
        u2.dimScale u1 (dim G * d⁻¹) • ∫ (x : M), f x ∂ μ) := by
      rw [← HasDim.scaleUnit_apply]
    _ = (u1.dimScale u2 (dim G) * (u2.dimScale u1 d) *
        u2.dimScale u1 (dim G * d⁻¹)) • ∫ (x : M), f x ∂ μ := by
      simp [smul_smul]
      ring_nf
    _ = ((u1.dimScale u2 (dim G) * u2.dimScale u1 (dim G))
        * (u2.dimScale u1 d * u1.dimScale u2 d)) • ∫ (x : M), f x ∂ μ := by
      congr 1
      conv_lhs => simp only [map_mul]
      rw [LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScale_of_inv_eq_swap]
      ring
    _ = ∫ (x : M), f x ∂ μ := by simp

name: component_npow
statement:
private lemma component_npow (component : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase → Exponent)
    (b : LTMCTDimensionBase) (h : ∀ d, d.exponent b = component d)
    (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) (n : ℕ) :
    component (d ^ n) = n • component d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    component (d ^ n) = (d ^ n).exponent b := (h _).symm
    _ = n • d.exponent b := npow_exponent d n b
    _ = n • component d := congrArg (n • ·) (h _)

name: component_epow
statement:
lemma component_epow (component : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase → Exponent)
    (b : LTMCTDimensionBase) (h : ∀ d, d.exponent b = component d)
    (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) (c : Exponent) :
    component (d ^ c) = component d * c
proof:
:= by
  calc
    component (d ^ c) = (d ^ c).exponent b := (h _).symm
    _ = d.exponent b * c := epow_exponent d c b
    _ = component d * c := congrArg (· * c) (h _)

lemma prod_univ_ISQDimensionBase {M : Type} [CommMonoid M] (f : ISQDimensionBase → M) :
    ∏ b, f b = f .length * f .mass * f .time * f .current * f .temperature
      * f .amount * f .luminousIntensity

    ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]

name: dimScale_transitive
statement:
lemma dimScale_transitive (u1 u2 u3 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (d : Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase) :
    dimScale u1 u2 d * dimScale u2 u3 d = dimScale u1 u3 d
proof:
:= by
  simp [dimScale]
  trans ((u1.length / u2.length) ^ (d.length : ℝ) * (u2.length / u3.length) ^ (d.length : ℝ)) *
    ((u1.time / u2.time) ^ (d.time : ℝ) * (u2.time / u3.time) ^ (d.time : ℝ)) *
    ((u1.mass / u2.mass) ^ (d.mass : ℝ) * (u2.mass / u3.mass) ^ (d.mass : ℝ)) *
    ((u1.charge / u2.charge) ^ (d.charge : ℝ) * (u2.charge / u3.charge) ^ (d.charge : ℝ)) *
    ((u1.temperature / u2.temperature) ^ (d.temperature : ℝ) *
      (u2.temperature / u3.temperature) ^ (d.temperature : ℝ))
  · ring
  repeat rw [← mul_rpow]
  rw [LengthUnit.div_mul_div, TimeUnit.div_mul_div, MassUnit.div_mul_div,
    ChargeUnit.div_mul_div, TemperatureUnit.div_mul_div]

name: fromISQHom_comp_toISQHom
statement:
lemma fromISQHom_comp_toISQHom :
    fromISQHom.comp toISQHom = MonoidHom.id (Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase)
proof:
:= by
  refine MonoidHom.ext fun d => Dimension.ext fun b => ?_
  cases b <;> simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, MonoidHom.id_apply, toISQHom_apply,
    fromISQHom_apply, fromISQFun, toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent]
  all_goals ring

name: toISQHom_injective
statement: lemma toISQHom_injective : Function.Injective toISQHom
proof:
:= by
  intro d1 d2 h
  have key : ∀ b : ISQDimensionBase, (toISQFun d1).exponent b = (toISQFun d2).exponent b := by
    intro b
    have hb := congrArg (fun d => Dimension.exponent d b) h
    simpa only [toISQHom_apply] using hb
  ext b
  cases b with
  | length => simpa only [toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent] using key .length
  | time =>
      have ht := key .time
      have hc := key .current
      simp only [toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent] at ht hc
      linarith
  | mass => simpa only [toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent] using key .mass
  | charge => simpa only [toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent] using key .current
  | temperature => simpa only [toISQFun, ofFunction_exponent] using key .temperature

:= fun y =>

private lemma gcdAux_eq_nat_gcd (fuel m n : Nat) (m_lt_fuel : m < fuel) :

  induction fuel generalizing m n with
  | zero => omega

proof:

  simp only [dimScale, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [← NNReal.mul_rpow]
  congr 1
  rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (u2.scale b), mul_div_mul_right _ _ (u2.scale_pos b).ne']

  /- We show that `EnergyMassWithDimNot` is not dimensionally correct by
    changing from `SI` to `SIPrimed` with values of `E`, `m` and `c` all equal to `1`. -/
  use SI, SIPrimed, ⟨1⟩, ⟨1⟩, ⟨1⟩
  unfold EnergyMassWithDimNot
  norm_num [WithDim.scaleUnit_val, M𝓭, NNReal.smul_def]

name: energyMass_isDimensionallyCorrect
statement:
lemma energyMass_isDimensionallyCorrect :
    IsDimensionallyCorrect EnergyMass
proof:
:= by
  /- Scale such that the unit u1 is taken to u2. -/
  intro u1 u2
  /- Let `m` be the mass, `E` be the energy and `u` be the actual units we start with. -/
  funext m E u
  unfold EnergyMass
  simp only [eq_iff_iff, UnitDependent.scaleUnit_apply_fun_left,
    UnitDependent.scaleUnit_apply_fun, Dimensionful.of_scaleUnit, dim_apply,
    WithDim.scaleUnit_val, WithDim.smul_val, map_mul, mul_pow, NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul,
    NNReal.coe_mul]
  ring_nf
  simp [mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, dimScale_ne_zero]

name: fderiv_apply_scaleUnit
statement:
lemma fderiv_apply_scaleUnit (u1 u2 : LTMCTUnitChoices) (x dm : M1)
    (f : M1 → M2) (hf : IsDimensionallyCorrect f) (f_diff : Differentiable ℝ f) :
    fderiv ℝ f (scaleUnit u2 u1 x) dm =
    u2.dimScale u1 (dim M2) • u1.dimScale u2 (dim M1) • fderiv ℝ f x dm
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hf u2 u1]
  change (fderiv ℝ ((u2.dimScale u1 (dim M2)).1 • fun mx => f
      ((u1.dimScale u2 (dim M1)).1 • mx)) ((u2.dimScale u1 (dim M1)).1 • x)) dm = _
  rw [fderiv_const_smul (by fun_prop), fderiv_comp_smul]
  simp [smul_smul]
  rfl

name: fderiv_isDimensionallyCorrect
statement:
lemma fderiv_isDimensionallyCorrect (f : M1 → M2) (hf : IsDimensionallyCorrect f)
    (f_diff : Differentiable ℝ f) :
    IsDimensionallyCorrect (fderiv ℝ f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isDimensionallyCorrect_fun_iff]
  intro u1 u2 m
  ext m'
  simp only [ContinuousLinearUnitDependent.scaleUnit_apply_fun]
  rw [fderiv_apply_scaleUnit u1 u2 m (scaleUnit u2 u1 m') f hf f_diff]
  simp [HasDim.scaleUnit_apply, smul_smul]

name: fderiv_dimension_const_direction

lemma fderiv_dimension_const_direction (dm : M1) (f : M1 → M2) (hf : IsDimensionallyCorrect f)

      fderiv ℝ f x dm = v.1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [isDimensionallyCorrect_fun_iff, funext_iff, WithDim.scaleUnit_val,
    fderiv_apply_scaleUnit _ _ _ dm f hf f_diff,
    ← smul_smul, ← LTMCTUnitChoices.dimScale_symm]

lemma norm_euclidean_if_orthonormal [h : Fact frame.Orthonormal] :
    ∀ v : frame.Vector, ‖v‖^2 = ∑ i, (v.components i)^2
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  let basis := (frame.basis (frame.timeEquiv 0)).toOrthonormalBasis (h.out _)
  calc
    _ = ‖basis.repr.symm (WithLp.toLp 2 v.components)‖ ^ 2 := by rfl
    _ = ‖WithLp.toLp 2 v.components‖ ^ 2 := by rw [basis.repr.symm.norm_map]
    _ = _ := EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq _

name: inner_euclidean_if_orthonormal
statement:
lemma inner_euclidean_if_orthonormal [h : Fact frame.Orthonormal] :
    ∀ v w : frame.Vector, inner ℝ v w = ∑ i, v.components i * w.components i
proof:
:= by
  intro v w
  let basis := (frame.basis (frame.timeEquiv 0)).toOrthonormalBasis (h.out _)
  calc
    _ = inner ℝ (basis.repr.symm <| WithLp.toLp 2 v.components)
        (basis.repr.symm <| WithLp.toLp 2 w.components) := by rfl
    _ = inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 v.components) _ := by rw [basis.repr.symm.inner_map_map]
    _ = _ := by rw [PiLp.inner_apply]; simp_rw [Real.inner_apply]

name: kB_pos
statement: lemma kB_pos : 0 < kB
proof: := kBAx.2

name: kB_nonneg
statement: lemma kB_nonneg : 0 ≤ kB
proof: := le_of_lt kBAx.2

name: kB_ne_zero
statement: lemma kB_ne_zero : kB ≠ 0

name: eulerLagrangeOp_eq
statement:
lemma eulerLagrangeOp_eq (L : Time → X → X → ℝ) (q : Time → X) :
    eulerLagrangeOp L q = fun t => gradient (L t · (∂ₜ q t)) (q t)
    - ∂ₜ (fun t' => gradient (L t' (q t') ·) (∂ₜ q t')) t
proof: := by rfl

name: eulerLagrangeOp_zero
statement:
lemma eulerLagrangeOp_zero (q : Time → X) :
    eulerLagrangeOp (fun _ _ _ => 0) q = fun _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eulerLagrangeOp_eq, Time.deriv_eq]

name: euler_lagrange_varGradient
statement:
theorem euler_lagrange_varGradient
    (L : Time → X → X → ℝ) (q : Time → X)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿L) :
    (δ (q':=q), ∫ t, L t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) = eulerLagrangeOp L q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerLagrangeOp_eq, Time.deriv_eq]
  apply HasVarGradientAt.varGradient
  apply HasVarGradientAt.intro _
  · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.comp
      (F := fun (φ : Time → X × X) t => L t (φ t).fst (φ t).snd)
      (G := fun (φ : Time → X) t => (φ t, fderiv ℝ φ t 1))
    · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.fmap (f := fun t => ↿(L t))
      · fun_prop
      · fun_prop
      intro x u
      apply DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt
      apply ContDiff.differentiable (n := ∞) (by fun_prop) (by simp)
    · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.prod (F:=fun φ => φ)
      · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.id _ hq
      · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.fderiv (hu := hq)
  case hgrad =>
    funext t
    simp (disch := fun_prop) [sub_eq_add_neg]
    congr
    all_goals
      try funext t
      rw [gradient_eq_adjFDeriv, adjFDeriv_uncurry] <;>
        apply ContDiff.differentiable (n := ∞) (by fun_prop) (by simp)

name: hamiltonEqOp_eq
statement:
lemma hamiltonEqOp_eq (H : Time → X → X → ℝ) (p : Time → X) (q : Time → X) :
    hamiltonEqOp H p q = fun t => (∂ₜ q t + -gradient (fun x => H t x (q t)) (p t),
      - ∂ₜ p t + -gradient (fun x => H t (p t) x) (q t))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero_iff_hamiltons_equations
statement:
lemma hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero_iff_hamiltons_equations (H : Time → X → X → ℝ)
    (p : Time → X) (q : Time → X) :
    hamiltonEqOp H p q = 0 ↔
    (∀ t, ∂ₜ q t = gradient (fun x => H t x (q t)) (p t)) ∧
    (∀ t, ∂ₜ p t = -gradient (fun x => H t (p t) x) (q t))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hamiltonEqOp_eq, funext_iff, Prod.mk_eq_zero, forall_and, add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq]

name: hamiltons_equations_varGradient
statement:
theorem hamiltons_equations_varGradient
    (H : Time → X → X → ℝ) (pq : Time → X × X) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ pq)
    (hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿H) :
    (δ (pq':= pq), ∫ t, ⟪(pq' t).1, ∂ₜ (Prod.snd ∘ pq') t⟫_ℝ - H t (pq' t).1 (pq' t).2) =
    fun t => hamiltonEqOp H (fun t => (pq t).1) (fun t => (pq t).2) t
proof:
:= by
  apply HasVarGradientAt.varGradient
  apply HasVarGradientAt.intro _
  · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.add
    · let i := fun (t : Time) (x : X × X) => ⟪x.1, x.2⟫_ℝ
      apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.comp
        (F := fun (φ : Time → X × X) t => i t (φ t))
        (G := fun (φ : Time → X × X) t => ((φ t).1, fderiv ℝ (Prod.snd ∘ φ) t 1))
      · exact HasVarAdjDerivAt.fmap _ _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
          fun x _ => (by fun_prop : DifferentiableAt ℝ _ _).hasAdjFDerivAt
      · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.prod
        · exact HasVarAdjDerivAt.fst (HasVarAdjDerivAt.id _ (by fun_prop))
        · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.fderiv' (F := fun (φ : Time → X × X) t => (φ t).2)
          exact HasVarAdjDerivAt.fmap _ _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
            fun x _ => (by fun_prop : DifferentiableAt ℝ _ _).hasAdjFDerivAt
    · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.neg
      exact HasVarAdjDerivAt.fmap (fun t => ↿(H t)) _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        fun x _ => (((by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ _).differentiable
          (by simp)).differentiableAt).hasAdjFDerivAt
  · simp only [adjFDeriv_prod_snd, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, zero_add]
    funext x
    rw [adjFDeriv_uncurry
      ((by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ _).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt]
    simp only [Prod.neg_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    rw [adjFDeriv_inner]
    simp only [one_smul]
    conv_rhs =>
      enter [2, 1, 1, 1, 2, x]
      rw [adjFDeriv_inner]
      simp
    rw [← gradient_eq_adjFDeriv, ← gradient_eq_adjFDeriv]
    rfl
    all_goals exact ((by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ ∞ _).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt

name: val_ne_zero

name: div_eq_val

name: div_ne_zero

lemma div_ne_zero (x y : MassUnit) : ¬ x / y = (0 : ℝ≥0)

name: div_pos

proof:

name: scale_div_scale

lemma scale_div_scale (x1 x2 : MassUnit) {r1 r2 : ℝ} (hr1 : 0 < r1) (hr2 : 0 < r2) :
