name: accel_zero
statement:
lemma accel_zero (s : FreeParticle) (q : Trajectory) (h : ∀ t, s.NewtonsSecondLaw q t) :
    ∀ t, deriv (deriv q) t = 0
proof:
:=
  fun t => (mul_eq_zero.mp (h t)).resolve_left s.mass_pos.ne'

name: velocity_const_of_zero_acc
statement:
lemma velocity_const_of_zero_acc (q : Time → ℝ) (h : ∀ t, deriv (deriv q) t = 0)
    (hcont : ContDiff ℝ 2 q) : ∃ v₀, ∀ t, deriv q t = v₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨deriv q 0, fun t => ?_⟩
  refine is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := deriv q) ?_ ?_ t 0
  · unfold Time.deriv
    fun_prop
  · intro t
    ext p
    have hp : p = p.val • (1 : Time) := Time.ext (by simp)
    rw [hp, zero_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq, h t, mul_zero]

name: linearMomentum_conserved_of_velocity_const
statement:
lemma linearMomentum_conserved_of_velocity_const (s : FreeParticle) (q : Trajectory)
    (h : ∃ v₀, ∀ t, s.velocity q t = v₀) :
    ∃ p, ∀ t, s.linearMomentum q t = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv⟩ := h
  exact ⟨s.mass * v₀, fun t => by simp [linearMomentum, hv]⟩

name: linearMomentum_conserved
statement:
theorem linearMomentum_conserved (s : FreeParticle) (q : Trajectory)
    (h : ∀ t, s.NewtonsSecondLaw q t) (hcont : ContDiff ℝ 2 q) :
    ∃ p, ∀ t, s.linearMomentum q t = p
proof:
:=
  linearMomentum_conserved_of_velocity_const s q
    (velocity_const_of_zero_acc q (accel_zero s q h) hcont)

name: kineticEnergy_conserved
statement:
theorem kineticEnergy_conserved (s : FreeParticle) (q : Trajectory)
    (h : ∀ t, s.NewtonsSecondLaw q t) (hcont : ContDiff ℝ 2 q) :
    ∃ E, ∀ t, s.kineticEnergy q t = E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv⟩ := velocity_const_of_zero_acc q (accel_zero s q h) hcont
  refine ⟨(1 / 2) * s.mass * v₀^2, fun t => ?_⟩
  simp only [kineticEnergy, velocity, hv]

name: isTotalTimeDerivative_explicit
statement:
lemma isTotalTimeDerivative_explicit {δL : Time → X → X → ℝ} :
    IsTotalTimeDerivative δL ↔  (∃ (F : Time → X → ℝ) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿F),
    ∀ t q v, δL t q v = fderiv ℝ ↿F (t, q) ((1 : Time), v))
proof:
:= by
  
  let tq := fun (q : Time → X) t => (t, q t)
  have h_tq_contDiff : ∀ (q : Time → X), ContDiff ℝ ∞ q -> ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tq q) := by
    fun_prop
  have h_tq_der :  ∀ (q : Time → X) t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ q -> ∂ₜ (tq q) t = (1, ∂ₜ q t) := by
    intro q t h_ContDiff_q
    ext
    change (∂ₜ (tq q) t).1.val = (1 : Time).val
    congr
    apply Eq.symm
    calc
      (1 : Time) = fderiv ℝ (fun (t' : Time) => t') t 1 := by simp only [fderiv_fun_id,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id', id_eq]
      _ = fderiv ℝ (fun (t' : Time) => (tq q t').1) t 1 := by rfl
      _ = (∂ₜ (tq q) t).1 := by
        rw [fderiv.fst]
        · simp
          rfl
        · apply ContDiffAt.differentiableAt
          · apply ContDiff.contDiffAt
            exact h_tq_contDiff q h_ContDiff_q
          · by_contra
            rcases this
    apply Eq.symm
    calc
       (1, ∂ₜ q t).2 = fderiv ℝ (fun t' => (tq q t').2) t 1 := by rfl
       _ = (∂ₜ (tq q) t).2 := by
        rw [fderiv.snd]
        · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd']
          rfl
        · apply ContDiffAt.differentiableAt
          · apply ContDiff.contDiffAt
            exact h_tq_contDiff q h_ContDiff_q
          · by_contra
            rcases this
  have h_F_tq_der : ∀ (q : Time → X) (F : Time → X → ℝ) t, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿F) → (ContDiff ℝ ∞ q)  →
      ∂ₜ (fun t' => ↿F (t', q t')) t = fderiv ℝ ↿F (t, q t) ((1 : Time), ∂ₜ q t) := by
    intro q F t hF hq
    change  fderiv ℝ ((↿F) ∘ (tq q)) t 1 = fderiv ℝ ↿F (t, q t) ((1 : Time), ∂ₜ q t)
    rw [fderiv_comp]
    · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [← Time.deriv_eq,h_tq_der]
      exact hq
    · apply ContDiffAt.differentiableAt
      · apply ContDiff.contDiffAt
        exact hF
      · by_contra
        rcases this
    · apply ContDiffAt.differentiableAt
      · apply ContDiff.contDiffAt
        exact h_tq_contDiff q hq
      · by_contra
        rcases this
  
  constructor
  
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨F, hF⟩
    rcases hF with ⟨hFdif, hFder⟩
    use F
    use hFdif
    intro t q₀ v
    let qv := fun (t' : Time) => (q₀ - t.val • v) + t'.val • v
    have h_qv_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ qv := by
      change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (((fun (tR : ℝ) => (q₀ - t.val • v) + tR • v)) ∘ Time.toRealCLE)
      fun_prop
    have h_qv_t : qv t = q₀ := by
      calc
        qv t = (q₀ - t.val • v) + t.val • v := by rfl
        _ = q₀ := by module
    have h_qv_der : ∂ₜ qv t = v := by
      calc
        ∂ₜ qv t = fderiv ℝ (fun t' => (q₀ - t.val • v) + t'.val • v) t 1 := by rfl
        _ = v := by
          rw [fderiv_const_add,fderiv_smul_const]
          · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, fderiv_val, one_smul]
          · fun_prop
    rw [← h_qv_t, ← h_qv_der, hFder, ← h_F_tq_der]
    · rfl
    · exact hFdif
    · exact h_qv_contDiff
    · exact h_qv_contDiff
  
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨F, hF⟩
    rcases hF with ⟨hFdif, hFder⟩
    use F
    use hFdif
    intro t q hq_ContDiff
    rw [hFder, ← h_F_tq_der]
    · rfl
    · exact hFdif
    · exact hq_ContDiff

name: isTotalTimeDerivative_neg
statement:
lemma isTotalTimeDerivative_neg {δL : Time → X → X → ℝ} (h :  IsTotalTimeDerivative δL) :
    IsTotalTimeDerivative (- δL)
proof:
:= by
    rcases h with ⟨F, h_ContDiff, hF⟩
    set F_neg := (fun t q => - F t q)
    use F_neg
    have h_neg_F_ContDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿F_neg := by
      fun_prop
    use  h_neg_F_ContDiff
    intro t q hq
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    rw [hF t q hq]
    unfold F_neg
    unfold Time.deriv
    simp only [fderiv_fun_neg, _root_.neg_apply]

name: totalTimeDerivative_contDiff
statement:
lemma totalTimeDerivative_contDiff {δL : Time → X → X → ℝ} (h : IsTotalTimeDerivative δL):
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿δL
proof:
:= by
 rcases isTotalTimeDerivative_explicit.mp h with ⟨F, hContDiff, heq⟩
 let Fder_v := Prod.map (fderiv ℝ ↿(fun t q => F t q)) (fun (v : X) => v )
 let regroup := ↿(fun (t : Time) (q : X) (v : X) => ((t, q), v))
 let appv := fun (FV : ((Time × X →L[ℝ] ℝ) × X )) => FV.fst (1, FV.snd)
 have hδL : ↿δL = appv ∘ Fder_v ∘ regroup := by
   funext tqv
   rcases tqv with ⟨t, q, v⟩
   simp only [Function.comp_apply]
   change δL t q v = appv (Fder_v (regroup (t, q, v)))
   rw [heq t q v]
   rfl
 rw [hδL]
 unfold appv
 unfold Fder_v
 unfold regroup
 fun_prop

name: totalTimeDerivative_hasZeroVarGradient
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨F,hF_contDiff, hF⟩
  let traj_deriv := fun (G : Time → ℝ) t => fderiv ℝ G t 1
  let F_traj := fun (q : Time → X) t => F t (q t)
  apply HasVarGradientAt.intro _
  · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.congr (F := fun q' => traj_deriv (F_traj q'))
    · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.comp (F := traj_deriv) (G := F_traj)
      · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.fderiv
        fun_prop
      · apply HasVarAdjDerivAt.fmap (f := fun t => F t)
        · exact hq
        · fun_prop
        · intro t x
          apply DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply ContDiff.differentiable
          fun_prop
          decide
    · intro q' hq'
      funext t'
      rw [hF t' q' hq']
      rfl
  funext t
  unfold adjFDeriv
  simp [adjoint_eq_clm_adjoint]

name: totalTimeDerivative_hasVarGradientAt_equivalence
statement:
lemma totalTimeDerivative_hasVarGradientAt_equivalence [CompleteSpace X] (L δL : Time → X → X → ℝ)
    (hδL : IsTotalTimeDerivative δL)
    (q : Time → X)    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (grad : Time → X)
    (hgrad :  HasVarGradientAt (fun q' t => L t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ  q' t 1)) grad q) :
    HasVarGradientAt (fun q' t => (L + δL) t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) grad q
proof:
:= by
  have h_add_zero : grad = grad + (fun _ => 0) := by
    funext t
    simp
  rw [h_add_zero]
  apply HasVarGradientAt.add
  · exact hgrad
  · exact totalTimeDerivative_hasZeroVarGradient hδL q hq

name: totalTimeDerivative_varGradient_equivalenvce
statement:
lemma totalTimeDerivative_varGradient_equivalenvce [CompleteSpace X] (L L' : Time → X → X → ℝ)
    (htot : IsTotalTimeDerivative (L' - L))
    (q : Time → X) (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q):
    (δ (q':=q), ∫ t, L' t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) =
       (δ (q':=q), ∫ t, L t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1))
proof:
:= by
  let δL := (fun t q v => L' t q v - L t q v)
  by_cases hL : ∃ grad, HasVarGradientAt (fun q' t => L t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) grad q
  · apply HasVarGradientAt.varGradient
    have h_triv : L' = L + (L' - L) := by module
    rw [h_triv]
    apply totalTimeDerivative_hasVarGradientAt_equivalence
    · exact htot
    · exact hq
    · rcases hL with ⟨grad, hgrad⟩
      rw [ HasVarGradientAt.varGradient (fun q' t => L t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ  q' t 1)) grad q hgrad]
      exact hgrad
  · by_cases hL' : ∃ grad, HasVarGradientAt (fun q' t => L' t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) grad q
    · apply Eq.symm
      apply HasVarGradientAt.varGradient
      have h_triv : L = L' +(-(L' - L)) := by module
      rw [h_triv]
      apply totalTimeDerivative_hasVarGradientAt_equivalence
      · apply isTotalTimeDerivative_neg
        exact htot
      · exact hq
      · rcases hL' with ⟨grad, hgrad⟩
        rw [HasVarGradientAt.varGradient (fun q' t => L' t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ  q' t 1)) grad q hgrad]
        exact hgrad
    · unfold varGradient
      simp only [hL, hL', ↓reduceDIte]

name: totalTimeDerivative_eulerLagrange_equivalenvce
statement:
lemma totalTimeDerivative_eulerLagrange_equivalenvce [CompleteSpace X] (L L' : Time → X → X → ℝ)
    (htot : IsTotalTimeDerivative (L' - L)) (hContDiff : (ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿L) ∨ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿L'))
    (q : Time → X) (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) : eulerLagrangeOp L q = eulerLagrangeOp L' q
proof:
:= by
  rcases (isTotalTimeDerivative_explicit.mp htot) with ⟨F, hFContDiff, hEq⟩
  have hContDiff_both :  (ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿L) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ ↿L') := by
    cases hContDiff with
      | inl hL =>
        constructor
        · exact hL
        · have h_triv : ↿L' =  ↿L + ↿(L' - L) := by
            funext tqv
            rcases tqv with ⟨t, q', v⟩
            rw [Pi.add_apply]
            change L' t q' v = L t q' v + (L' - L) t q' v
            simp
          have h_δL_contDiff := totalTimeDerivative_contDiff htot
          rw [h_triv]
          exact hL.add h_δL_contDiff
      | inr hL' =>
        constructor
        · have h_triv : ↿L =  ↿L' + ↿(-(L' - L)) := by
            funext tqv
            rcases tqv with ⟨t, q', v⟩
            rw [Pi.add_apply]
            change L t q' v = L' t q' v + (- (L' - L)) t q' v
            simp
          have h_δL_contDiff := totalTimeDerivative_contDiff (isTotalTimeDerivative_neg htot)
          rw [h_triv]
          exact hL'.add h_δL_contDiff
        · exact hL'
  rw [← euler_lagrange_varGradient L q hq hContDiff_both.left]
  rw [← euler_lagrange_varGradient L' q hq hContDiff_both.right]
  apply Eq.symm
  apply totalTimeDerivative_varGradient_equivalenvce
  · exact htot
  · exact hq

name: isTotalTimeDerivativeVelocity
statement:
lemma isTotalTimeDerivativeVelocity  [CompleteSpace X]
    (δL : X → ℝ)
    (hδL0 : δL 0 = 0)
    (h : IsTotalTimeDerivative (fun _ _ v => δL v)) :
    ∃ g : X, ∀ v, δL v = ⟪g, v⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases (isTotalTimeDerivative_explicit.mp h) with ⟨F, hFdiff, hEq⟩

  
  let dF : (Time  × X) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    fderiv ℝ ↿F ((0 : Time), (0 : X))

  
  have h_time : dF ((1 : Time), (0 : X)) = 0 := by
    have h0 :
        δL (0 : X) =
          fderiv ℝ ↿F ((0 : Time), (0 : X))
            ((1 : Time), (0 : X)) := by
      simpa using (hEq (0 : Time) (0 : X)
        (0 : X))
    have : dF ((1 : Time), (0 : X)) =
        δL (0 : X) := by
      simpa [dF] using h0.symm
    simpa [hδL0] using this

  
  let φ : X →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    dF.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ Time X)

  
  have hφ : ∀ v : X, δL v = φ v := by
    intro v
    have hv :
        δL v =
          fderiv ℝ ↿F ((0 : Time), (0 : X))
            ((1 : Time), v) := by
      simpa using (hEq (0 : Time) (0 : X) v)
    have hv' : δL v = dF ((1 : Time), v) := by
      simpa [dF] using hv
    calc
      δL v = dF ((1 : Time), v) := hv'
     _ = dF (((0  : Time), v) + ((1 : Time), (0 : X))) := by simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, zero_add,
        add_zero]
      _ = dF ((0 : Time), v) + dF ((1 : Time), (0 : X)) := by
        simpa using
          (dF.map_add ((0 : Time), v) ((1 : Time), (0 : X)))
      _ = dF ((0 : Time), v) := by
        simp [h_time]
      _ = φ v := by
        simp [φ]

  
  refine ⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (X)).symm φ, ?_⟩
  intro v
  have hinner :
      ⟪(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (X)).symm φ, v⟫_ℝ = φ v := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ)
        (E := X) (x := v) (y := φ)]
  calc
    δL v = φ v := hφ v
    _ = ⟪(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ (X)).symm φ, v⟫_ℝ := by
      rw [hinner.symm]

name: inverse_

name: kineticEnergy_eq
statement:
lemma kineticEnergy_eq (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    kineticEnergy S xₜ = fun t => (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.m * ⟪∂ₜ xₜ t, ∂ₜ xₜ t⟫_ℝ
proof: := by rfl

name: potentialEnergy_eq
statement:
lemma potentialEnergy_eq (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :

proof: := by rfl

name: energy_eq
statement:
lemma energy_eq (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :

name: kineticEnergy_differentiable
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma kineticEnergy_differentiable (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (kineticEnergy S xₜ)

name: potentialEnergy_differentiable
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma potentialEnergy_differentiable (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun t => potentialEnergy S (xₜ t))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ xₜ := hx.differentiable (by simp)
  simp only [potentialEnergy_eq]

name: energy_differentiable
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma energy_differentiable (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :

name: kineticEnergy_deriv
statement:
lemma kineticEnergy_deriv (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    ∂ₜ (kineticEnergy S xₜ) = fun t => ⟪∂ₜ xₜ t, S.m • ∂ₜ (∂ₜ xₜ) t⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  unfold kineticEnergy
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (∂ₜ xₜ) t :=
    (deriv_differentiable_of_contDiff xₜ hx).differentiableAt
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_const_mul (by fun_prop), _root_.smul_apply,
    fderiv_inner_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) hd hd, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  simp [inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm]
  ring

name: potentialEnergy_deriv
statement:
lemma potentialEnergy_deriv (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    ∂ₜ (fun t => potentialEnergy S (xₜ t)) = fun t => ⟪∂ₜ xₜ t, S.k • xₜ t⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ xₜ t := (hx.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
  simp only [potentialEnergy_eq, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_const_mul (by fun_prop), _root_.smul_apply,
    fderiv_inner_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) hd hd, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  simp [inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm]
  ring

name: energy_deriv
statement:
lemma energy_deriv (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    ∂ₜ (energy S xₜ) = fun t => ⟪∂ₜ xₜ t, S.m • ∂ₜ (∂ₜ xₜ) t + S.k • xₜ t⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  unfold energy
  funext t
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_add (by fun_prop) (S.potentialEnergy_differentiable xₜ hx t)]
  simp only [_root_.add_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq, kineticEnergy_deriv _ _ hx,
    potentialEnergy_deriv _ _ hx, ← inner_add_right]

name: lagrangian_eq
statement:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
lemma lagrangian_eq : lagrangian S = fun t x v =>
    1 / (2 : ℝ) * S.m * ⟪v, v⟫_ℝ - 1 / (2 : ℝ) * S.k * ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  ext t x v
  simp [lagrangian, potentialEnergy, mul_assoc]

name: lagrangian_eq_kineticEnergy_sub_potentialEnergy
statement:
lemma lagrangian_eq_kineticEnergy_sub_potentialEnergy (t : Time)
    (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    lagrangian S t (xₜ t) (∂ₜ xₜ t) = kineticEnergy S xₜ t - potentialEnergy S (xₜ t)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: contDiff_lagrangian
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma contDiff_lagrangian (n : WithTop ℕ∞) : ContDiff ℝ n ↿S.lagrangian
proof:
:= by
  rw [lagrangian_eq]
  fun_prop

name: gradient_lagrangian_position_eq
statement:
lemma gradient_lagrangian_position_eq (t : Time) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    gradient (fun x => lagrangian S t x v) x = - S.k • x
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => lagrangian S t y v) =
      fun y => (-(1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k) * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ + (1 / (2 : ℝ) * S.m * ⟪v, v⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext y; simp only [lagrangian_eq]; ring
  rw [h_eq, gradient_add_const, gradient_const_mul_inner_self]
  module

name: gradient_lagrangian_velocity_eq
statement:
lemma gradient_lagrangian_velocity_eq (t : Time) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    gradient (lagrangian S t x) v = S.m • v
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => lagrangian S t x y) =
      fun y => ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.m) * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ + (-(1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k * ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext y; simp only [lagrangian_eq]; ring
  change gradient (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => lagrangian S t x y) v = S.m • v
  rw [h_eq, gradient_add_const, gradient_const_mul_inner_self]
  module

name: gradLagrangian_eq_eulerLagrangeOp
statement:
lemma gradLagrangian_eq_eulerLagrangeOp (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    gradLagrangian S xₜ = eulerLagrangeOp S.lagrangian xₜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradLagrangian, euler_lagrange_varGradient _ _ hq (S.contDiff_lagrangian _)]

name: equationOfMotion_iff_gradLagrangian_zero
statement:
lemma equationOfMotion_iff_gradLagrangian_zero (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    S.EquationOfMotion xₜ ↔ S.gradLagrangian xₜ = 0
proof: := by rfl

name: force_eq_linear
statement: lemma force_eq_linear (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) : force S x = - S.k • x
proof:
:= by
  have hpot : potentialEnergy S = fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) =>
      ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k) * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ := by
    funext y
    simp [potentialEnergy, mul_assoc]
  unfold force
  rw [hpot, gradient_const_mul_inner_self]
  module

name: gradLagrangian_eq_force
statement:
lemma gradLagrangian_eq_force (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    S.gradLagrangian xₜ = fun t => force S (xₜ t) - S.m • ∂ₜ (∂ₜ xₜ) t
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  rw [gradLagrangian_eq_eulerLagrangeOp S xₜ hx, eulerLagrangeOp]
  simp [gradient_lagrangian_position_eq, gradient_lagrangian_velocity_eq, force_eq_linear,
    Time.deriv_smul _ S.m (deriv_differentiable_of_contDiff xₜ hx)]

name: equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law
statement:
lemma equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    S.EquationOfMotion xₜ ↔
    (∀ t, S.m • ∂ₜ (∂ₜ xₜ) t = force S (xₜ t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [EquationOfMotion, gradLagrangian_eq_force S xₜ hx, funext_iff]
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero]
  exact forall_congr' fun t => eq_comm

name: energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion
statement:
lemma energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ)
    (h : S.EquationOfMotion xₜ) : ∂ₜ (S.energy xₜ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law _ _ hx] at h
  funext t
  rw [energy_deriv _ _ hx]
  simp [h, force_eq_linear]

name: energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion'
statement:
lemma energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion' (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ)
    (h : S.EquationOfMotion xₜ) (t : Time) : S.energy xₜ t = S.energy xₜ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (energy_differentiable S xₜ hx)
  intro t
  ext p
  rw [p.eq_one_smul, map_smul, ← Time.deriv_eq,
    S.energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion xₜ hx h]
  simp

name: toCanonicalMomentum_eq
statement:
lemma toCanonicalMomentum_eq (t : Time) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    toCanonicalMomentum S t x v = S.m • v
proof:
:=
  gradient_lagrangian_velocity_eq S t x v

name: hamiltonian_eq
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_eq :
    hamiltonian S = fun _ p x => (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * (1 / S.m) * ⟪p, p⟫_ℝ +
      (1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k * ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  funext t x p
  simp only [hamiltonian, toCanonicalMomentum, lagrangian_eq, one_div, LinearEquiv.coe_symm_mk',
    inner_smul_right, inner_smul_left, map_inv₀, ringHom_apply]
  field_simp
  ring

name: hamiltonian_contDiff
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma hamiltonian_contDiff (n : WithTop ℕ∞) : ContDiff ℝ n ↿S.hamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  rw [hamiltonian_eq]
  fun_prop

name: gradient_hamiltonian_position_eq
statement:
lemma gradient_hamiltonian_position_eq (t : Time) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    gradient (hamiltonian S t p) x = S.k • x
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => hamiltonian S t p y) =
      fun y => ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k) * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ +
        ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * (1 / S.m) * ⟪p, p⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext y
    simp only [hamiltonian_eq]
    ring
  change gradient (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => hamiltonian S t p y) x = S.k • x
  rw [h_eq, gradient_add_const, gradient_const_mul_inner_self]
  module

name: gradient_hamiltonian_momentum_eq
statement:
lemma gradient_hamiltonian_momentum_eq (t : Time) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    gradient (hamiltonian S t · x) p = (1 / S.m) • p
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => hamiltonian S t y x) =
      fun y => ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * (1 / S.m)) * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ +
        ((1 / (2 : ℝ)) * S.k * ⟪x, x⟫_ℝ) := by
    funext y
    simp only [hamiltonian_eq]
  change gradient (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) => hamiltonian S t y x) p = (1 / S.m) • p
  rw [h_eq, gradient_add_const, gradient_const_mul_inner_self]
  module

name: hamiltonian_eq_energy
statement:
lemma hamiltonian_eq_energy (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) :
    (fun t => hamiltonian S t (toCanonicalMomentum S t (xₜ t) (∂ₜ xₜ t)) (xₜ t)) = energy S xₜ
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  rw [hamiltonian_eq]
  unfold energy kineticEnergy potentialEnergy
  simp only [toCanonicalMomentum_eq, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, smul_eq_mul, ringHom_apply]
  field_simp

name: equationOfMotion_iff_hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero
statement:
lemma equationOfMotion_iff_hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) : S.EquationOfMotion xₜ ↔
    hamiltonEqOp S (fun t => S.toCanonicalMomentum t (xₜ t) (∂ₜ xₜ t)) xₜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hamiltonEqOp, hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero_iff_hamiltons_equations]
  simp [toCanonicalMomentum_eq, gradient_hamiltonian_momentum_eq, gradient_hamiltonian_position_eq]
  rw [equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law _ _ hx]
  simp [Time.deriv_smul _ S.m (deriv_differentiable_of_contDiff xₜ hx), force_eq_linear]

name: equationOfMotion_tfae
statement:
lemma equationOfMotion_tfae (xₜ : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ xₜ) :
    List.TFAE [S.EquationOfMotion xₜ,
      (∀ t, S.m • ∂ₜ (∂ₜ xₜ) t = force S (xₜ t)),
      hamiltonEqOp S (fun t => S.toCanonicalMomentum t (xₜ t) (∂ₜ xₜ t)) xₜ = 0,
      (δ (q':=xₜ), ∫ t, lagrangian S t (q' t) (fderiv ℝ q' t 1)) = 0,
      (δ (pq':= fun t => (S.toCanonicalMomentum t (xₜ t) (∂ₜ xₜ t), xₜ t)),
        ∫ t, ⟪(pq' t).1, ∂ₜ (Prod.snd ∘ pq') t⟫_ℝ - S.hamiltonian t (pq' t).1 (pq' t).2) = 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equationOfMotion_iff_hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero, ← equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law]
  rw [hamiltons_equations_varGradient, euler_lagrange_varGradient]
  simp only [List.tfae_cons_self]
  rw [← gradLagrangian_eq_eulerLagrangeOp, ← equationOfMotion_iff_gradLagrangian_zero]
  simp only [List.tfae_cons_self]
  erw [← equationOfMotion_iff_hamiltonEqOp_eq_zero]
  simp only [List.tfae_cons_self, List.tfae_singleton]
  repeat fun_prop
  simp [toCanonicalMomentum_eq]
  repeat fun_prop

name: x
statement:
@[simp]
lemma x₀_zero : x₀ 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: v
statement:
@[simp]
lemma v₀_zero : v₀ 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: trajectory_eq
statement:
lemma trajectory_eq (IC : InitialConditions) :
    IC.trajectory S = fun t : Time => cos (S.ω * t) • IC.x₀ + (sin (S.ω * t)/S.ω) • IC.v₀
proof: := rfl

name: trajectory_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma trajectory_zero : trajectory S 0 = fun _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [trajectory_eq]

name: trajectory_contDiff
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma trajectory_contDiff (S : HarmonicOscillator) (IC : InitialConditions) {n : WithTop ℕ∞} :
    ContDiff ℝ n (IC.trajectory S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trajectory_eq]
  have h : ContDiff ℝ n (Time.val : Time → ℝ) := Time.toRealCLM.contDiff
  fun_prop

name: trajectory_velocity
statement:
lemma trajectory_velocity (IC : InitialConditions) : ∂ₜ (IC.trajectory S) =
    fun t : Time => - S.ω • sin (S.ω * t.val) • IC.x₀ + cos (S.ω * t.val) • IC.v₀
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  rw [trajectory_eq, Time.deriv, fderiv_fun_add (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rw [fderiv_smul_const (by fun_prop), fderiv_smul_const (by fun_prop)]
  have h1 : (fderiv ℝ (fun t => sin (S.ω * t.val) / S.ω) t) =
    (1/ S.ω) • (fderiv ℝ (fun t => sin (S.ω * t.val)) t) := by
    rw [← fderiv_mul_const]
    congr
    funext t
    field_simp
    fun_prop
  simp [h1]
  rw [fderiv_cos (by fun_prop), fderiv_sin (by fun_prop),
    fderiv_fun_mul (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp only [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero, add_zero, neg_smul,
    _root_.neg_apply, FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, fderiv_val,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  field_simp [S.ω_ne_zero]
  module

name: trajectory_acceleration
statement:
lemma trajectory_acceleration (IC : InitialConditions) : ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (IC.trajectory S)) =
    fun t : Time => - S.ω^2 • cos (S.ω * t.val) • IC.x₀ - S.ω • sin (S.ω * t.val) • IC.v₀
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  rw [trajectory_velocity, Time.deriv, fderiv_fun_add (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rw [fderiv_smul_const (by fun_prop), fderiv_fun_const_smul (by fun_prop),
    fderiv_smul_const (by fun_prop)]
  simp only [neg_smul, add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  rw [fderiv_cos (by fun_prop), fderiv_sin (by fun_prop),
    fderiv_fun_mul (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  field_simp [smul_smul]
  simp only [fderiv_fun_const, Pi.ofNat_apply, smul_zero, add_zero, _root_.neg_apply,
    FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, fderiv_val,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one, neg_smul]
  module

statement:

name: trajectory_equationOfMotion
statement:
lemma trajectory_equationOfMotion (IC : InitialConditions) :
    EquationOfMotion S (IC.trajectory S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EquationOfMotion, gradLagrangian_eq_force (S := S) (xₜ := IC.trajectory S)
    (trajectory_contDiff S IC)]
  funext t
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [trajectory_acceleration, force_eq_linear]
  ext
  have hωm : S.ω ^ 2 * S.m = S.k := by
    rw [ω_sq]
    field_simp [m_ne_zero S]
  simp [trajectory_eq, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_comm]
  rw [← hωm]
  field_simp [ω_ne_zero S]
  ring

name: trajectories_unique
statement:
lemma trajectories_unique (IC : InitialConditions) (x : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x) :
    S.EquationOfMotion x ∧ x 0 = IC.x₀ ∧ ∂ₜ x 0 = IC.v₀ →
    x = IC.trajectory S
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hEOM, hx0, hv0⟩
  have hTraj : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (IC.trajectory S) := by fun_prop
  
  have dsub : ∀ f g : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1),
      Differentiable ℝ f → Differentiable ℝ g →
      ∂ₜ (fun t => f t - g t) = fun t => ∂ₜ f t - ∂ₜ g t := by
    intro f g hf hg
    funext t
    simp only [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hf t) (hg t), sub_apply]
  
  
  set y : Time → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) := fun t => x t - IC.trajectory S t with hydef
  have hyContDiff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ y := hx.sub hTraj
  have hy_deriv : ∂ₜ y = fun t => ∂ₜ x t - ∂ₜ (IC.trajectory S) t :=
    dsub x _ (hx.differentiable (by simp)) (hTraj.differentiable (by simp))
  have hy_deriv2 : ∂ₜ (∂ₜ y) = fun t => ∂ₜ (∂ₜ x) t - ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (IC.trajectory S)) t := by
    rw [hy_deriv]
    exact dsub _ _ (deriv_differentiable_of_contDiff _ hx)
      (deriv_differentiable_of_contDiff _ hTraj)
  have hNewt_x := (S.equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law x hx).1 hEOM
  have hNewt_traj := (S.equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law (IC.trajectory S) hTraj).1
    (trajectory_equationOfMotion S IC)
  have hEOM_y : S.EquationOfMotion y :=
    (S.equationOfMotion_iff_newtons_2nd_law y hyContDiff).2 fun t => by
      rw [hy_deriv2]
      simp [smul_sub, hNewt_x, hNewt_traj, hydef, force_eq_linear]
  have hE : ∀ t, S.energy y t = 0 := fun t =>
    (S.energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion' y hyContDiff hEOM_y t).trans <| by
      have hy0 : y 0 = 0 := by simp [hydef, hx0]
      have hyv0 : ∂ₜ y 0 = 0 := by
        rw [congrFun hy_deriv 0, hv0, trajectory_velocity_at_zero S IC]; simp
      simp [HarmonicOscillator.energy, HarmonicOscillator.kineticEnergy,
        HarmonicOscillator.potentialEnergy, hy0, hyv0, one_div, smul_eq_mul]
  
  funext t
  have hk : 0 ≤ S.kineticEnergy y t := by
    simp only [HarmonicOscillator.kineticEnergy]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) S.m_pos.le) real_inner_self_nonneg
  have hp : 0 ≤ S.potentialEnergy (y t) := by
    simp only [HarmonicOscillator.potentialEnergy, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg S.k_pos.le real_inner_self_nonneg)
  have hpe : S.potentialEnergy (y t) = 0 := ((add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hk hp).mp (hE t)).2
  simp only [HarmonicOscillator.potentialEnergy, smul_eq_mul] at hpe
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hpe with h | h
  · norm_num at h
  · have hyt : x t - IC.trajectory S t = 0 :=
      inner_self_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left S.k_ne_zero)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hyt

name: trajectory_energy
statement:
lemma trajectory_energy (IC : InitialConditions) : S.energy (IC.trajectory S) =
    fun _ => 1/2 * (S.m * ‖IC.v₀‖ ^2 + S.k * ‖IC.x₀‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  rw [energy_conservation_of_equationOfMotion' _ _ (by fun_prop) (trajectory_equationOfMotion S IC)]
  simp [energy, kineticEnergy, potentialEnergy]
  ring

name: toInitialConditions_trajectory_at_t
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toInitialConditions_trajectory_at_t₀ (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditionsAtTime) :
    (IC.toInitialConditions S).trajectory S IC.t₀ = IC.xT₀
proof:
:= by

  ext i
  simp only [smul_add, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: toInitialConditions_fromInitialConditions
statement:
lemma toInitialConditions_fromInitialConditions (S : HarmonicOscillator)
    (IC : InitialConditions) :
    (fromInitialConditions S IC).toInitialConditions S = IC
proof:
:= by
  have hω : S.ω ≠ 0 := S.ω_ne_zero
  set z : ℂ := (⟨IC.x₀ 0, IC.v₀ 0 / S.ω⟩ : ℂ)
  
  have hcos : ‖z‖ * cos (Complex.arg z) = z.re := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have hsin : ‖z‖ * sin (Complex.arg z) = z.im := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  
  have hre : z.re = IC.x₀ 0 := rfl
  have him : z.im = IC.v₀ 0 / S.ω := rfl
  apply InitialConditions.ext
  · 
    show EuclideanSpace.single 0 (‖z‖ * cos (Complex.arg z)) = IC.x₀
    rw [hcos, hre]
    ext i; fin_cases i; simp
  · 
    show EuclideanSpace.single 0 (‖z‖ * S.ω * sin (Complex.arg z)) = IC.v₀
    have hv : ‖z‖ * S.ω * sin (Complex.arg z) = IC.v₀ 0 := by
      rw [mul_right_comm, hsin, him]; field_simp
    rw [hv]
    ext i; fin_cases i; simp

name: trajectory_eq_cos
statement:
lemma trajectory_eq_cos (IC : InitialConditions) (t : Time) :
    IC.trajectory S t =
      EuclideanSpace.single 0 ((AmplitudePhase.fromInitialConditions S IC).A *
        cos (S.ω * t - (AmplitudePhase.fromInitialConditions S IC).φ))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← AmplitudePhase.toInitialConditions_fromInitialConditions S IC]
  exact AmplitudePhase.toInitialConditions_trajectory_eq_cos S
    (AmplitudePhase.fromInitialConditions S IC) t

    ∂ₜ (IC.trajectory S) t =

        sin (S.ω * t.val - (AmplitudePhase.fromInitialConditions S IC).φ)))
proof:
