    funext fun a => funext fun b => by simp [kroneckerDelta, Equiv.swap_apply_eq_iff]
  rw [leviCivitaSymbol_eq_det, h, Matrix.det_permute', Equiv.Perm.sign_swap hij,
    ← leviCivitaSymbol_eq_det]
  simp

name: leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
lemma leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_eq {g : ι → ι} {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (h : g i = g j) :
    leviCivitaSymbol g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [leviCivitaSymbol_eq_det]
  exact Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hij (funext fun c => by rw [h])

name: leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_not_injective
statement:
lemma leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_not_injective {g : ι → ι} (h : ¬ Function.Injective g) :
    leviCivitaSymbol g = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Function.Injective, not_forall] at h
  obtain ⟨i, j, hgij, hij⟩ := h
  exact leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_eq hij hgij

name: leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_iff {g : ι → ι} :
    leviCivitaSymbol g = 0 ↔ ¬ Function.Injective g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h hinj => ?_, leviCivitaSymbol_eq_zero_of_not_injective⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ⇑σ = g :=
    ⟨Equiv.ofBijective g (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.mp hinj), rfl⟩
  rw [leviCivitaSymbol_perm] at h
  exact Units.ne_zero (Equiv.Perm.sign σ) h

name: exists_isUnit_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma exists_isUnit_intervalIntegral [Nontrivial E] (U : AddChar ℝ E) (hU : Continuous U) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ IsUnit (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..d, U x)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : 0 < ‖(1 : E)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr one_ne_zero
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ‖U x - 1‖ < ‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ / 2 := by
    have hmem : Set.Iio (‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ / 2) ∈ 𝓝 ‖U 0 - 1‖ := by
      simpa using Iio_mem_nhds (by positivity : 0 < ‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ / 2)
    exact (continuous_norm.comp (hU.sub continuous_const)).continuousAt hmem
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrU⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  let d := r / 2
  have hd : 0 < d := by positivity
  let q : Eˣ := {
    val := d • 1
    inv := d⁻¹ • 1
    val_inv := by rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hd.ne', one_smul, one_mul]
    inv_val := by rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd.ne', one_smul, one_mul] }
  refine ⟨d, hd, (Units.ofNearby q _ ?_).isUnit⟩
  calc
    _ = ‖(∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..d, U x) - d • (1 : E)‖ := rfl
    _ = ‖(∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..d, U x) - ∫ _x in (0 : ℝ)..d, (1 : E)‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero]
    _ = ‖∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..d, (U x - 1)‖ := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hU.intervalIntegrable 0 d)
        (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 d)]
    _ ≤ (‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ / 2) * |d - 0| :=
      intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun x hx => by
        apply le_of_lt
        apply hrU
        rw [Real.dist_0_eq_abs]
        rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hd.le] at hx
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hx.1.le]
        exact hx.2.trans_lt (by dsimp [d]; linarith))
    _ = (‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ / 2) * d := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hd]
    _ < d * ‖(1 : E)‖⁻¹ := by nlinarith [inv_pos.mpr hone]
    _ = ‖q.inv‖⁻¹ := by simp [q, norm_smul, mul_comm, abs_of_pos hd]

name: mul_intervalIntegral_eq_sub
statement:
lemma mul_intervalIntegral_eq_sub (U : AddChar ℝ E) (hU : Continuous U) (s t : ℝ) :
    U s * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, U x =
      (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(s + t), U x) - ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..s, U x
proof:
:= by
  let L : E →L[ℝ] E :=
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (U s)).mkContinuous ‖U s‖ (fun x => norm_mul_le _ _)
  calc
    _ = L (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, U x) := rfl
    _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, L (U x) :=
      (L.intervalIntegral_comp_comm (hU.intervalIntegrable 0 t)).symm
    _ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, U (s + x) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro x _
      exact (U.map_add_eq_mul s x).symm
    _ = ∫ x in s..(s + t), U x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_left, add_zero]
    _ = (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(s + t), U x) - ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..s, U x := by
      rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
        (hU.intervalIntegrable 0 s) (hU.intervalIntegrable s (s + t))

name: differentiable
statement:
lemma differentiable [Nontrivial E] (U : AddChar ℝ E) (hU : Continuous U) :
    Differentiable ℝ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, _, hV⟩ := exists_isUnit_intervalIntegral U hU
  let V : E := ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..d, U x
  let v : Eˣ := hV.unit
  have hv : (v : E) = V := hV.unit_spec
  let F : ℝ → E := fun t => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..t, U x
  have hF (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (U t) t :=
    (hU.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt
  have htranslate (t : ℝ) : U t * V = F (t + d) - F t :=
    mul_intervalIntegral_eq_sub U hU t d
  intro t
  have hR : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (s + d) - F s)
      (U (t + d) - U t) t := by
    exact (HasDerivAt.comp_add_const t d (hF (t + d))).sub (hF t)
  have heq : U = fun s : ℝ => (F (s + d) - F s) * (↑v⁻¹ : E) := by
    funext s
    calc
      U s = (U s * (v : E)) * (↑v⁻¹ : E) := by simp
      _ = (F (s + d) - F s) * (↑v⁻¹ : E) := by rw [hv, htranslate]
  rw [heq]
  exact (hR.mul_const (↑v⁻¹ : E)).differentiableAt

name: apply_eq_exp_smul_deriv
statement:
lemma apply_eq_exp_smul_deriv (U : AddChar ℝ E) (hU : Continuous U) (t : ℝ) :
    U t = NormedSpace.exp (t • deriv U 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial E with
  | inl _ => exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | inr _ =>
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ U := differentiable U hU
    let A : E := deriv U 0
    have hUderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt U (U t * A) t := by
      have ht : HasDerivAt U (deriv U t) t :=
        hdiff.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have h0 : HasDerivAt U (deriv U 0) 0 :=
        hdiff.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hleft : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => U (t + s)) (deriv U t) 0 :=
        HasDerivAt.comp_const_add t 0 (by simpa using ht)
      have hright : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => U t * U s) (U t * A) 0 := by
        dsimp only [A]
        exact HasDerivAt.const_mul (U t) h0
      have heq : (fun s : ℝ => U (t + s)) = fun s : ℝ => U t * U s := by
        funext s
        exact U.map_add_eq_mul t s
      have hder : deriv U t = U t * A := hleft.unique (heq ▸ hright)
      rwa [← hder]
    let G : ℝ → E := fun t => U t * NormedSpace.exp (t • (-A))
    have hG : Differentiable ℝ G := fun t =>
      ((hUderiv t).mul (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const (-A) t)).differentiableAt
    have hGder (t : ℝ) : deriv G t = 0 := by
      apply ((hUderiv t).mul (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const (-A) t)).deriv.trans
      have hcomm : Commute A (NormedSpace.exp (t • (-A))) := by
        exact ((Commute.refl A).neg_right.smul_right t).exp_right
      rw [mul_assoc, hcomm.eq]
      noncomm_ring
    have hconst (t : ℝ) : G t = G 0 := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hG hGder t 0
    have hone : U t * Ring.inverse (NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) = 1 := by
      simpa [G, ← Ring.inverse_exp] using hconst t
    have hexp : IsUnit (NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) := NormedSpace.isUnit_exp (t • A)
    let e : Eˣ := hexp.unit
    have he : (e : E) = NormedSpace.exp (t • A) := hexp.unit_spec
    rw [← he, Ring.inverse_unit] at hone
    calc
      U t = (U t * (↑e⁻¹ : E)) * (e : E) := by simp
      _ = NormedSpace.exp (t • A) := by
        rw [hone, one_mul, he]

name: generator_unique
statement:
lemma generator_unique (U : AddChar ℝ E) (A : E)
    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, U t = NormedSpace.exp (t • A)) : A = deriv U 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [funext h, (hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const A (0 : ℝ)).deriv]

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext {U V : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H} (h : ∀ t, U t = V t) : U = V
proof:
:= by
  cases U
  cases V
  congr
  exact AddChar.ext _ _ h

name: apply_eq_exp_deriv
statement:
lemma apply_eq_exp_deriv (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) :
    U t = NormedSpace.exp ((t : ℂ) • deriv U 0)
proof:
:=
  OneParameterSubgroup.apply_eq_exp_smul_deriv U.toAddChar U.continuous t

name: adjoint_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma adjoint_eq (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) : (U t).adjoint = U (-t)
proof:
:= by
  apply left_inv_eq_right_inv (Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem (U.mem_unitary t))
  simp [← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]

name: apply_eq_exp_generator
statement:
lemma apply_eq_exp_generator (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) :
    U t = NormedSpace.exp ((-(t : ℂ) * Complex.I) • U.generator)
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.apply_eq_exp_deriv]
  apply congrArg NormedSpace.exp
  rw [generator, smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun z : ℂ => z • deriv U 0)
  rw [mul_assoc, Complex.I_mul_I]
  simp

name: generator_unique
statement:
lemma generator_unique (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (A : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ∀ t : ℝ, U t = NormedSpace.exp ((-(t : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A)) :
    A = U.generator
proof:
:= by
  have hrep : ∀ t : ℝ, U t =
      NormedSpace.exp ((t : ℂ) • ((-Complex.I) • A)) := by
    intro t
    rw [h t]
    congr 1
    rw [smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hderiv : (-Complex.I) • A = deriv U 0 :=
    OneParameterSubgroup.generator_unique U.toAddChar ((-Complex.I) • A)
      (fun t => by simpa only [Complex.coe_smul] using hrep t)
  calc
    A = Complex.I • ((-Complex.I) • A) := by rw [smul_smul]; simp
    _ = Complex.I • deriv U 0 := by rw [hderiv]
    _ = U.generator := rfl

name: adjoint_deriv_eq_neg
statement:
lemma adjoint_deriv_eq_neg (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) :
    (deriv U 0).adjoint = -deriv U 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : H →L[ℂ] H := deriv U 0
  refine (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr ?_).symm
  refine (OneParameterSubgroup.generator_unique U.toAddChar (-A.adjoint) fun t ↦ ?_).symm
  calc
    _ = (U (-t)).adjoint := by simp
    _ = (NormedSpace.exp (((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) • A)).adjoint := by simp [A, U.apply_eq_exp_deriv]
    _ = NormedSpace.exp (((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) • A).adjoint := NormedSpace.star_exp _
    _ = NormedSpace.exp (t • -A.adjoint) := by
      simp [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, Complex.coe_smul]

name: generator_isSelfAdjoint
statement: lemma generator_isSelfAdjoint (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) : IsSelfAdjoint U.generator
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSelfAdjoint.I_smul_of_mem_skewAdjoint
  rw [skewAdjoint.mem_iff]
  exact U.adjoint_deriv_eq_neg

name: commute_generator
statement:
lemma commute_generator (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) :
    Commute U.generator (U t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [U.apply_eq_exp_generator]
  exact ((Commute.refl U.generator).smul_right (-(t : ℂ) * Complex.I)).exp_right

name: hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt U (U t * (-(Complex.I • U.generator))) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (U : ℝ → H →L[ℂ] H) =
      fun s : ℝ => NormedSpace.exp ((s : ℂ) • deriv U 0) by
    funext s
    exact U.apply_eq_exp_deriv s]
  simpa [generator, smul_smul] using
    hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const (deriv U 0) t

name: hasDerivAt_star
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_star (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => star (U s)) (star (U t) * (Complex.I • U.generator)) t
proof:
:= by
  have heq :
      star (U t * (-(Complex.I • U.generator))) =
        star (U t) * (Complex.I • U.generator) := by
    calc
      star (U t * (-(Complex.I • U.generator))) =
          (Complex.I • U.generator) * star (U t) := by
        rw [star_mul, star_neg, star_smul, U.generator_isSelfAdjoint.star_eq]
        simp
      _ = star (U t) * (Complex.I • U.generator) := by
        have hcomm := (U.commute_generator (-t)).smul_left Complex.I
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, U.adjoint_eq]
        exact hcomm.eq
  rw [← heq]
  exact (U.hasDerivAt t).star

name: ofSelfAdjoint_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofSelfAdjoint_apply {A : H →L[ℂ] H} (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (t : ℝ) :
    ofSelfAdjoint hA t = NormedSpace.exp ((-(t : ℂ) * Complex.I) • A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofSelfAdjoint]
  change NormedSpace.exp ((t : ℂ) • ((-Complex.I) • A)) = _
  rw [smul_smul]
  ring_nf

name: ofSelfAdjoint_generator
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofSelfAdjoint_generator (U : UnitaryOneParameterGroup H) :
    ofSelfAdjoint U.generator_isSelfAdjoint = U
proof:
:= by
  apply ext
  intro t
  rw [ofSelfAdjoint_apply, U.apply_eq_exp_generator]

name: generator_ofSelfAdjoint
statement:
@[simp]
lemma generator_ofSelfAdjoint {A : H →L[ℂ] H} (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    (ofSelfAdjoint hA).generator = A
proof:
:=
  ((ofSelfAdjoint hA).generator_unique A (ofSelfAdjoint_apply hA)).symm

name: gradient_add_const
statement:
lemma gradient_add_const {f : F → ℝ} (c : ℝ) (x : F) :
    gradient (fun y => f y + c) x = gradient f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gradient
  rw [fderiv_add_const]

name: gradient_const_mul
statement:
lemma gradient_const_mul {f : F → ℝ} {x : F} (c : ℝ) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) :
    gradient (fun y => c * f y) x = c • gradient f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gradient
  rw [fderiv_const_mul hf, map_smul]

name: gradient_inner_self
statement: lemma gradient_inner_self (x : F) : gradient (fun y : F => ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ) x = (2 : ℝ) • x
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_inner_right (𝕜 := ℝ) fun y => ?_
  unfold gradient
  rw [toDual_symm_apply,
    fderiv_inner_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) differentiableAt_fun_id differentiableAt_fun_id]
  simp [real_inner_comm, inner_smul_right, two_mul]

name: gradient_const_mul_inner_self
statement:
lemma gradient_const_mul_inner_self (c : ℝ) (x : F) :
    gradient (fun y : F => c * ⟪y, y⟫_ℝ) x = (2 * c) • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradient_const_mul c (differentiableAt_fun_id.inner ℝ differentiableAt_fun_id),
    gradient_inner_self, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: gradient_coord
statement:
lemma gradient_coord {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    gradient (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => y i) x = EuclideanSpace.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => y i)
      (innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) x :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).hasFDerivAt.congr_fderiv
      (by ext y; simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left])
  exact h.hasGradientAt.gradient.trans ((toDual ℝ _).symm_apply_apply _)

name: gradient_comp_coord
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => f (y i))
      (innerSL ℝ (f' • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) x :=
    (hf.comp_hasFDerivAt x (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).hasFDerivAt).congr_fderiv
      (by ext y; simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, smul_eq_mul])
  exact h.hasGradientAt.gradient.trans ((toDual ℝ _).symm_apply_apply _)

name: divergence_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divergence_zero : divergence 𝕜 (fun _ : E => 0) = fun _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold divergence
  simp

name: divergence_eq_sum_fderiv
statement:
lemma divergence_eq_sum_fderiv {s : Finset E} (b : Basis s 𝕜 E) {f : E → E} :
    divergence 𝕜 f = fun x => ∑ i : s, b.repr (fderiv 𝕜 f x (b i)) i
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  unfold divergence
  rw[LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace_of_finset (s:=s) _ b]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  rfl

name: divergence_eq_sum_fderiv'
statement:
lemma divergence_eq_sum_fderiv' {ι} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι 𝕜 E) {f : E → E} :
    divergence 𝕜 f = fun x => ∑ i, b.repr (fderiv 𝕜 f x (b i)) i
proof:
:= by
  let s : Finset E := Finset.univ.map ⟨b, Basis.injective b⟩
  let f' : ι → s := fun i => ⟨b i, by simp [s]⟩
  have h : Function.Injective f' := by
    intro i j h
    simp [f'] at h
    exact Basis.injective b h
  have h' : Function.Surjective f' := by
    intro ⟨x, hx⟩
    simp [s] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp [f']
  let e : ι ≃ s := Equiv.ofBijective f' ⟨h, h'⟩
  let b' : Basis s 𝕜 E := b.reindex e
  rw [divergence_eq_sum_fderiv b']
  ext x
  rw [← e.symm.sum_comp]
  simp [b']

name: divergence_eq_space_div
statement:
lemma divergence_eq_space_div {d} (f : Space d → Space d)
    (h : Differentiable ℝ f) : divergence ℝ f = Space.div (Space.basis.repr ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  let b := (Space.basis (d:=d)).toBasis
  rw[divergence_eq_sum_fderiv' b]
  funext x
  simp +zetaDelta only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply,
    Space.basis_repr_apply, Space.div, Space.deriv, Function.comp_apply]
  congr
  funext i
  have h1 : (fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x i) x)
    = fderiv ℝ (Space.coordCLM i ∘ f) x := by
    congr
    ext j
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Space.coordCLM_apply, Space.coord_apply]
  rw [h1]
  rw [fderiv_comp]
  simp [Space.coordCLM_apply, Space.coord_apply]
  · fun_prop
  · exact h x

name: divergence_prodMk
statement:
lemma divergence_prodMk [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F]
    {f : E×F → E} {g : E×F → F} {xy : E×F}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f xy) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g xy) :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun xy : E×F => (f xy, g xy)) xy
    =
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x' => f (x',xy.2)) xy.1
    +
    divergence 𝕜 (fun y' => g (xy.1,y')) xy.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨bX⟩⟩ := Basis.exists_basis 𝕜 E
  have : Fintype s := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex bX
  obtain ⟨sY, ⟨bY⟩⟩ := Basis.exists_basis 𝕜 F
  have : Fintype sY := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex bY
  let bXY := bX.prod bY
  rw[divergence_eq_sum_fderiv' bX]
  rw[divergence_eq_sum_fderiv' bY]
  rw[divergence_eq_sum_fderiv' bXY]
  simp[hf.fderiv_prodMk hg,bXY,fderiv_wrt_prod hf,fderiv_wrt_prod hg]

name: divergence_add
statement:
lemma divergence_add {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => f x + g x) x
    =
    divergence 𝕜 f x + divergence 𝕜 g x
proof:
:= by
  unfold divergence
  simp [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]

name: divergence_neg
statement:
lemma divergence_neg {f : E → E} {x : E} :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => -f x) x = -divergence 𝕜 f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold divergence
  simp

name: divergence_sub
statement:
lemma divergence_sub {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => f x - g x) x
    =
    divergence 𝕜 f x - divergence 𝕜 g x
proof:
:= by
  unfold divergence
  simp [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]

name: divergence_const_smul
statement:
lemma divergence_const_smul {f : E → E} {x : E} {c : 𝕜}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => c • f x) x
    =
    c * divergence 𝕜 f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold divergence
  simp [fderiv_fun_const_smul hf]

name: divergence_smul
statement:
lemma divergence_smul [InnerProductSpace' 𝕜 E] {f : E → 𝕜} {g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x)
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => f x • g x) x
    = f x * divergence 𝕜 g x + ⟪adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x 1, g x⟫_𝕜
proof:
:= by
  have : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete 𝕜 E
  simp [divergence, fderiv_fun_smul hf hg, hf.hasAdjFDerivAt.hasAdjoint_fderiv.adjoint_inner_left]

name: hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 ↿F) (x₀ : M) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume))
      (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, fderiv ℝ (F · t) x₀ ∂(volume)) x₀
proof:
:= by
  let F' : M → ℝ → M →L[ℝ] N := fun x t => fderiv ℝ (F · t) x
  let s (x₀) : Set M := Metric.closedBall x₀ 1
  have hF' : Continuous ↿F' := by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsCompact.exists_isMaxOn (s := s x₀ ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ))
      ((isCompact_closedBall x₀ 1).prod isCompact_Icc)
      (f := fun (a : M × ℝ) => ‖F' a.1 a.2‖)
      (by simp [s])
      (continuous_norm.comp hF').continuousOn
  have hx := hf.differentiable (by simp)
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (s := s x₀)
    (F' := F') (bound := fun t => ‖F' a.1 a.2‖)
  · exact Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x₀ one_pos
  · filter_upwards with x
    apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    fun_prop
  · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop
  · apply Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Continuous.uncurry_left x₀ (by fun_prop)
  · filter_upwards with t h x hx
    exact ha.2 (Set.mk_mem_prod hx (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self (by simpa using h)))
  · exact intervalIntegrable_const
  · filter_upwards with t h x hx
    exact DifferentiableAt.hasFDerivAt (by fun_prop)

name: fderiv_apply_parameteric_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma fderiv_apply_parameteric_intervalIntegral
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 ↿F) (x₀ : M) (v : M) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume)) x₀ v =
      ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, fderiv ℝ (F · t) x₀ v ∂(volume)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff hf x₀).fderiv]
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply ?_ v
  apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
  fun_prop

name: fderiv_parameteric_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma fderiv_parameteric_intervalIntegral
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 ↿F) (x₀ : M) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume)) =
      fun x => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, fderiv ℝ (F · t) x ∂(volume)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff hf x₀
  ext1 x
  exact (hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff hf x).fderiv

name: contDiff_one_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
statement:
lemma contDiff_one_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 ↿F) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume))
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_one_iff_hasFDerivAt]
  refine ⟨_, ?_, hasFDerivAt_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff hf⟩
  fun_prop

name: contDiff_succ_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
statement:
lemma contDiff_succ_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff {n : ℕ} [FiniteDimensional ℝ M]
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) ↿F) :
    ContDiff ℝ (n + 1) (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume))
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih generalizing F
  · exact contDiff_one_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff hf
  · rw [contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv]
    refine ⟨ContDiff.differentiable
      (contDiff_one_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff (hf.of_le (by simp))) (by simp), ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, WithTop.add_eq_top, WithTop.natCast_ne_top,
      WithTop.one_ne_top, or_self, IsEmpty.forall_iff, true_and, contDiff_clm_apply_iff,
      fderiv_apply_parameteric_intervalIntegral (hf.of_le (by simp))]
    exact fun y => ih (by fun_prop)

name: contDiff_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff
statement:
lemma contDiff_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff {n : ℕ} {M : Type}
    [NormedAddCommGroup M] [NormedSpace ℝ M] [ProperSpace M] [FiniteDimensional ℝ M]
    {F : M → ℝ → N} (hf : ContDiff ℝ n ↿F) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun (x : M) => ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, F x t ∂(volume))
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih generalizing F
  · exact contDiff_zero.mpr (by fun_prop)
  · exact contDiff_succ_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_contDiff (hf.of_le (by simp))

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
statement:
protected lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv {f : E → F} {f'} {x} (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) :

name: DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt
statement:
protected lemma DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : E → F} {x} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f (adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= hf
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    unfold adjFDeriv
    apply HasAdjoint.congr_adj
    · apply ContinuousLinearMap.hasAdjoint
    · funext y; simp[adjoint_eq_clm_adjoint]

name: adjoint.isBoundedBilinearMap_real
statement:
lemma adjoint.isBoundedBilinearMap_real :
    IsBoundedBilinearMap ℝ (fun (fy : (X →L[ℝ] Y)×Y) => fy.1.adjoint fy.2)

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.contDiffAt_deriv
statement:
protected lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.contDiffAt_deriv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [InnerProductSpace' ℝ F]
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [InnerProductSpace' ℝ G]
    [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : E → F → G} {f' : E → F → _} (hf : ∀ x y, HasAdjFDerivAt ℝ (f x) (f' x y) y)
    (hf' : ContDiff ℝ (n+1) (↿f)) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (fun x : E×F×G => f' x.1 x.2.1 x.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp[← fun x y => (hf x y).adjFDeriv]
  unfold adjFDeriv
  simp[adjoint_eq_clm_adjoint]
  apply ContDiff.fun_comp
  · fun_prop
  · apply ContDiff.fun_comp (𝕜:=ℝ) (n:=n)
      (g := fun fx : ((WithLp 2 F) →L[ℝ] (WithLp 2 G))×(WithLp 2 G) => fx.1.adjoint fx.2)
      (f := fun x : E×F×G => (((toL2 ℝ) ∘L
        ((fderiv ℝ (f x.1) x.2.1) ∘L (fromL2 ℝ))), (toL2 ℝ) x.2.2))
    · apply ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.isBoundedBilinearMap_real.contDiff
    · fun_prop

name: gradient_eq_adjFDeriv
statement:
lemma gradient_eq_adjFDeriv
    {f : U → 𝕜} {x : U} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :

name: adjFDeriv_id

name: adjFDeriv_id'

name: hasAdjFDerivAt_const

lemma hasAdjFDerivAt_const (x : E) (y : F) :

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.comp
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.comp {f : F → G} {g : E → F} {f' g'} {x : E}
    (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' (g x)) (hg : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 g g' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => f (g x)) (fun dz => g' (f' dz)) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by
    fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv_fun_comp]
    exact hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv.comp hg.hasAdjoint_fderiv

name: adjFDeriv_comp
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_comp [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : F → G} {g : E → F} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f (g x)) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => f (g x)) x = fun dy => adjFDeriv 𝕜 g x (adjFDeriv 𝕜 f (g x) dy)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.comp
  apply hf.hasAdjFDerivAt
  apply hg.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.prodMk
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.prodMk {f : E → F} {g : E → G} {f' g'} {x : E}

    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => (f x, g x)) (fun dyz => f' dyz.fst + g' dyz.snd) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [DifferentiableAt.fderiv_prodMk]
    apply HasAdjoint.prodMk
    · exact hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv
    · exact hg.hasAdjoint_fderiv

name: HasAjdFDerivAt.fst
statement:
lemma HasAjdFDerivAt.fst {f : E → F×G} {f'} {x : E} (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => (f x).fst) (fun dy => f' (dy, 0)) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv.fst]
    apply HasAdjoint.fst hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv

name: adjFDeriv_fst
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_fst [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : E → F×G} {x : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => (f x).fst) x = fun dy => adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x (dy, 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAjdFDerivAt.fst hf.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: adjFDeriv_prod_fst
statement:
@[simp]
lemma adjFDeriv_prod_fst [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] {x : F × E} :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (Prod.fst : F × E → F) x = fun a => (a, 0)
proof:
:= by
  change adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => (id x).fst) x = _
  rw [adjFDeriv_fst]
  funext dy
  rw [adjFDeriv_id']
  simp

name: HasAjdFDerivAt.snd
statement:
lemma HasAjdFDerivAt.snd {f : E → F×G} {f'} {x : E} (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => (f x).snd) (fun dz => f' (0, dz)) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv.snd]
    apply HasAdjoint.snd hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv

name: adjFDeriv_snd
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_snd [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : E → F×G} {x : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => (f x).snd) x = fun dy => adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x (0, dy)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAjdFDerivAt.snd hf.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: adjFDeriv_prod_snd
statement:
@[simp]
lemma adjFDeriv_prod_snd [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] {x : F × E} :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (Prod.snd : F × E → E) x = fun a => (0, a)
proof:
:= by
  change adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => (id x).snd) x = _
  rw [adjFDeriv_snd]
  funext dy
  rw [adjFDeriv_id']
  simp

name: hasAdjFDerivAt_uncurry
statement:
lemma hasAdjFDerivAt_uncurry {f : E → F → G} {xy} {fx' fy'}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (↿f) xy)
    (hfx : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (f · xy.2) fx' xy.1) (hfy : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (f xy.1 ·) fy' xy.2) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (↿f) (fun dz => (fx' dz, fy' dz)) xy where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:=hf
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    eta_expand
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv_uncurry]
    apply HasAdjoint.congr_adj
    case adjoint =>
      apply HasAdjoint.add
      apply HasAdjoint.comp (g:=Prod.fst) hfx.hasAdjoint_fderiv (HasAdjoint.fst hasAdjoint_id)
      apply HasAdjoint.comp (g:=Prod.snd) hfy.hasAdjoint_fderiv (HasAdjoint.snd hasAdjoint_id)
    case eq =>
      simp

name: adjFDeriv_uncurry
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_uncurry [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F] [CompleteSpace G]
    {f : E → F → G} {xy} (hfx : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 (↿f) xy) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (↿f) xy = fun dz => (adjFDeriv 𝕜 (f · xy.snd) xy.fst dz,
                                    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (f xy.fst ·) xy.snd dz)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply hasAdjFDerivAt_uncurry
  fun_prop
  apply DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt (by fun_prop)
  apply DifferentiableAt.hasAdjFDerivAt (by fun_prop)

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.neg
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.neg {f : E → F} {f'} {x : E} (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => - f x) (fun dy => - f' dy) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by simp; apply hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv.neg

name: adjFDeriv_neg
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_neg [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : E → F} {x : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => - f x) x = fun dy => - adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x dy
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.neg hf.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: HasAjdFDerivAt.add
statement:
lemma HasAjdFDerivAt.add {f g : E → F} {f' g'} {x : E}
    (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) (hg : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 g g' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => f x + g x) (fun dy => f' dy + g' dy) x where

:= by fun_prop

    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv_fun_add]
    apply hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv.add hg.hasAdjoint_fderiv

name: adjFDeriv_add
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_add [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f g : E → F} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => f x + g x) x = fun dy => adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x dy + adjFDeriv 𝕜 g x dy
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAjdFDerivAt.add
  apply hf.hasAdjFDerivAt
  apply hg.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.sub
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.sub
    {f g : E → F} {f' g'} {x : E}
    (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) (hg : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 g g' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => f x - g x) (fun dy => f' dy - g' dy) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv_fun_sub]

name: adjFDeriv_sub
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.sub
  apply hf.hasAdjFDerivAt
  apply hg.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.smul
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.smul {f : E → F} {g : E → 𝕜} {f' g'}
    (hf : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 f f' x) (hg : HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 g g' x) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt 𝕜 (fun x => g x • f x)
      (fun dy => conj (g x) • f' dy + g' (conj (inner 𝕜 dy (f x)))) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    simp (disch:=fun_prop) [fderiv_fun_smul,-inner_conj_symm']
    apply HasAdjoint.add
    · apply hf.hasAdjoint_fderiv.smul_left
    · apply hg.hasAdjoint_fderiv.smul_right

name: adjFDeriv_smul
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_smul [CompleteSpace E] [CompleteSpace F]
    {f : E → F} {g : E → 𝕜} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    adjFDeriv 𝕜 (fun x => g x • f x) x = fun dy => conj (g x) • adjFDeriv 𝕜 f x dy +
                                                  adjFDeriv 𝕜 g x (conj (inner 𝕜 dy (f x)))
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.smul
  apply hf.hasAdjFDerivAt
  apply hg.hasAdjFDerivAt

name: HasAdjFDerivAt.inner
statement:
lemma HasAdjFDerivAt.inner {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [InnerProductSpace' ℝ E] (x : E × E) :
    HasAdjFDerivAt ℝ (fun (x : E × E) => ⟪x.1, x.2⟫_ℝ) (fun y => y • (x.2, x.1)) x where
  differentiableAt
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  hasAdjoint_fderiv := by
    conv =>
      enter [2]
      change fun t => fderiv ℝ (fun x => ⟪x.1, x.2⟫_ℝ) x t
      enter [t]
      rw [fderiv_inner_apply' (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
      simp [fderiv_snd, fderiv_fst]
    constructor
    intro a b
    simp [inner_smul_left']
    conv_lhs =>
      enter [1]
      rw [real_inner_comm']
    ring

name: adjFDeriv_inner
statement:
lemma adjFDeriv_inner {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [InnerProductSpace' ℝ E]
    (x : E × E) :
    adjFDeriv ℝ (fun (x : E × E) => ⟪x.1, x.2⟫_ℝ) x =
      fun y => y • (x.2, x.1)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.adjFDeriv
  apply HasAdjFDerivAt.inner

name: dWirtingerDir_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_apply (g : V → ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerDir g v u
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ g u v - Complex.I * fderiv ℝ g u (Complex.I • v))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir, weightedDirDeriv, neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_apply (g : V → ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir g v u
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ g u v + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ g u (Complex.I • v))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir, weightedDirDeriv]

name: dWirtingerDir_const
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerDir_const (c : ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun _ : V => c) v u = 0
proof: := by simp [dWirtingerDir_apply]

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_const
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_const (c : ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (fun _ : V => c) v u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply]

name: dWirtingerDir_neg
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerDir_neg (g : V → ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun p => -(g p)) v u = -(dWirtingerDir g v u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, fderiv_fun_neg, _root_.neg_apply]
  ring

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_neg
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_neg (g : V → ℂ) (v u : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => -(g p)) v u = -(dWirtingerAntiDir g v u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, fderiv_fun_neg, _root_.neg_apply]
  ring

name: dWirtingerDir_add
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_add {g h : V → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u)
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (g + h) v u = dWirtingerDir g v u + dWirtingerDir h v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, fderiv_add hg hh, add_apply, mul_sub, mul_add,
    add_sub_add_comm]

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_add
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_add {g h : V → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u)
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (g + h) v u = dWirtingerAntiDir g v u + dWirtingerAntiDir h v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, fderiv_add hg hh, add_apply]
  ring

name: dWirtingerDir_smul
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_smul (c : ℂ) {g : V → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (c • g) v u = c • dWirtingerDir g v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, fderiv_const_smul hg c, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_smul
statement:

name: fderiv_mul_apply
proof:
:= by
  simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun (fderiv_mul hg hh) v

name: dWirtingerDir_mul
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_mul {g h : V → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u)
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (g * h) v u = dWirtingerDir g v u * h u + g u * dWirtingerDir h v u

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_mul
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_mul {g h : V → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u)
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h u) (v : V) :

name: dWirtingerDir_fun_sum
proof:
:= by

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_fun_sum

name: fderiv_star_eq
statement:
lemma fderiv_star_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : E → ℂ} {u : E} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun p : E => star (f p)) u =
      Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (fderiv ℝ f u)
proof:
:=
  (Complex.conjCLE.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp u hf.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

name: dWirtingerDir_star_comp
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_star_comp (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun p => star (f p)) v u = star (dWirtingerAntiDir f v u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, fderiv_star_eq hf]
  simp only [one_div, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    ContinuousAlgEquiv.coeCLE_apply, Complex.conjCAE_apply, star_mul', star_inv₀,
    star_ofNat, star_add, RCLike.star_def, Complex.conj_I, neg_mul,
    mul_eq_mul_left_iff, inv_eq_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, or_false]
  ring

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_star_comp
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_star_comp (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => star (f p)) v u = star (dWirtingerDir f v u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, dWirtingerDir_apply, fderiv_star_eq hf]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Complex.conjCLE_apply, Complex.star_def, map_mul, map_sub, map_div₀, map_one,
    map_ofNat, Complex.conj_I]
  ring

name: realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger
statement:
lemma realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger (L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) (w : ℂ) :
    L w =
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (L 1 - Complex.I * L Complex.I)) * w
        + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * (L 1 + Complex.I * L Complex.I)) * star w
proof:
:= by
  have hw : w = (w.re : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (w.im : ℝ) • Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  nth_rewrite 1 [hw, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
  apply Complex.ext <;> simp <;> ring

name: dWirtingerDir_comp
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_comp {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (f u))
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun p => g (f p)) v u =
      dWirtingerDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerDir f v u
        + dWirtingerAntiDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerDir (fun p => star (f p)) v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply]
  rw [show (fun p => g (f p)) = g ∘ f from rfl, fderiv_comp u hg hf, fderiv_star_eq hf]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Complex.conjCLE_apply, Complex.star_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger (fderiv ℝ g (f u)) (fderiv ℝ f u v),
    realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger (fderiv ℝ g (f u)) (fderiv ℝ f u (Complex.I • v))]
  ring

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_comp
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_comp {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (f u))
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => g (f p)) v u =
      dWirtingerDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerAntiDir f v u
        + dWirtingerAntiDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => star (f p)) v u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply]
  rw [show (fun p => g (f p)) = g ∘ f from rfl, fderiv_comp u hg hf, fderiv_star_eq hf]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    Complex.conjCLE_apply, Complex.star_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
    realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger (fderiv ℝ g (f u)) (fderiv ℝ f u v),
    realLinear_apply_eq_wirtinger (fderiv ℝ g (f u)) (fderiv ℝ f u (Complex.I • v))]
  ring

name: computes
statement:
theorem computes this composite's derivatives from the known derivative of `log`, swapping
the operator. Its anti-holomorphic derivative is `log`'s ordinary derivative `1/z` at the
mapped point `z̄`:

  `∂̄_z log(z̄) = 1/z̄`,

while its holomorphic derivative vanishes, `∂_z log(z̄) = 0`, because `log` is holomorphic.
So `log(z̄)` is purely anti-holomorphic, with its dependence carried by `∂̄`.

So precomposing with conjugation turns `∂` into `∂̄` and vice versa: a holomorphic `g(z̄)`
has zero holomorphic derivative, and its anti-holomorphic derivative is just `g`'s ordinary
complex derivative (§F, and the example above). The proof uses only `L`'s anti-commutation
with `i`, so it holds over any complex `V`, `V'`.

-/

section DomainConjugation

variable {V' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V'] [NormedSpace ℝ V'] [NormedSpace ℂ V']

omit [NormedSpace ℂ V] [NormedSpace ℂ V'] in
/
map is the map itself, the real Fréchet derivative of `g ∘ L` at `u`, applied to `x`, equals
the derivative of `g` at `L u` applied to `L x`. -/
private lemma fderiv_comp_clm_apply {g : V' → ℂ} {L : V →L[ℝ] V'} {u : V}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (L u)) (x : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun p => g (L p)) u x = fderiv ℝ g (L u) (L x)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp u L.hasFDerivAt).fderiv x

name: fderiv_comp_clm_apply
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp u L.hasFDerivAt).fderiv x

name: dWirtingerDir_comp_conjLinear
statement:
lemma dWirtingerDir_comp_conjLinear {g : V' → ℂ} {L : V →L[ℝ] V'} {u : V}
    (hL : ∀ x : V, L (Complex.I • x) = -(Complex.I • L x))
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (L u)) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun p => g (L p)) v u = dWirtingerAntiDir g (L v) (L u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, fderiv_comp_clm_apply hg, hL,
    map_neg]
  ring

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_comp_conjLinear
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_comp_conjLinear {g : V' → ℂ} {L : V →L[ℝ] V'} {u : V}
    (hL : ∀ x : V, L (Complex.I • x) = -(Complex.I • L x))
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (L u)) (v : V) :
    dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => g (L p)) v u = dWirtingerDir g (L v) (L u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, fderiv_comp_clm_apply hg, hL,
    map_neg]
  ring

name: dWirtingerDir_eq_of_clinear
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, h, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination -fderiv ℝ f u v / 2 * Complex.I_sq

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_zero_of_clinear
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, h, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination fderiv ℝ f u v / 2 * Complex.I_sq

name: dWirtingerDir_eq_zero_of_antilinear
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, h, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination fderiv ℝ f u v / 2 * Complex.I_sq

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_of_antilinear
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, h, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination -fderiv ℝ f u v / 2 * Complex.I_sq

name: hasFDerivAt_fderiv_apply
statement:
private lemma hasFDerivAt_fderiv_apply (hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
    (b : V) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => fderiv ℝ f p b)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℂ b).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)) u
proof:
:=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℂ b).hasFDerivAt.comp u hf'.hasFDerivAt

name: hasFDerivAt_weightedDirDeriv
statement:
private lemma hasFDerivAt_weightedDirDeriv (hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
    (c : ℂ) (b₁ b₂ : V) :
    HasFDerivAt (weightedDirDeriv f c b₁ b₂)
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℂ b₁).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
        + c • (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℂ b₂).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u))) u
proof:
:=
  ((hasFDerivAt_fderiv_apply hf' b₁).add
    ((hasFDerivAt_fderiv_apply hf' b₂).const_mul c)).const_mul (1 / 2)

name: fderiv_weightedDirDeriv
statement:
private lemma fderiv_weightedDirDeriv (hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
    (c : ℂ) (b₁ b₂ a : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (weightedDirDeriv f c b₁ b₂) u a
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a b₁
          + c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a b₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [(hasFDerivAt_weightedDirDeriv hf' c b₁ b₂).fderiv, add_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_add]

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv
statement:
private lemma dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv (w : V) :
    (fun p => dWirtingerAntiDir f w p) = weightedDirDeriv f Complex.I w (Complex.I • w)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: dWirtingerDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv
statement:
private lemma dWirtingerDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv (v : V) :
    (fun p => dWirtingerDir f v p) = weightedDirDeriv f (-Complex.I) v (Complex.I • v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: fderiv_dWirtingerAntiDir
statement:
private lemma fderiv_dWirtingerAntiDir (hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
    (w a : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun p => dWirtingerAntiDir f w p) u a
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a w
          + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a (Complex.I • w))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv, fderiv_weightedDirDeriv hf']

name: fderiv_dWirtingerDir
statement:
private lemma fderiv_dWirtingerDir (hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u)
    (v a : V) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun p => dWirtingerDir f v p) u a
      = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a v
          - Complex.I * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u a (Complex.I • v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerDir_eq_weightedDirDeriv, fderiv_weightedDirDeriv hf', neg_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: differentiableAt_dWirtingerDir
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_dWirtingerDir (hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u) (v : V) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p => dWirtingerDir f v p) u
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasFDerivAt_weightedDirDeriv
    ((hf2.fderiv_right (m := 1) le_rfl).differentiableAt one_ne_zero) _ _ _).differentiableAt

name: differentiableAt_dWirtingerAntiDir
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_dWirtingerAntiDir (hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u) (w : V) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p => dWirtingerAntiDir f w p) u
proof:
:= by
  exact (hasFDerivAt_weightedDirDeriv
    ((hf2.fderiv_right (m := 1) le_rfl).differentiableAt one_ne_zero) _ _ _).differentiableAt

name: dWirtingerDir_congr_of_eventuallyEq
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerDir_apply, h.fderiv_eq]

name: dWirtingerAntiDir_congr_of_eventuallyEq
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, h.fderiv_eq]

name: dWirtingerDir_dWirtingerAntiDir_comm
statement:
theorem dWirtingerDir_dWirtingerAntiDir_comm (hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f u) (v w : V) :
    dWirtingerDir (fun p => dWirtingerAntiDir f w p) v u
      = dWirtingerAntiDir (fun p => dWirtingerDir f v p) w u
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) u :=
    (hf2.fderiv_right (m := 1) le_rfl).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f u := hf2.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
  rw [dWirtingerDir_apply, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply]
  simp only [fderiv_dWirtingerAntiDir hf', fderiv_dWirtingerDir hf', hsymm.eq]
  ring

name: for
statement:
theorem for the coordinate operators, `∂_I ∂̄_J f = ∂̄_J ∂_I f` on
    `C²` `f`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The coordinate Wirtinger operators
- B. Properties of `dWirtingerCoord`
- C. Properties of `dWirtingerAntiCoord`
- D. Wirtinger chain rules for an outer function
- E. Schwarz's theorem for the coordinate operators

-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section

namespace Physlib.Wirtinger

variable {ι : Type*}

/-!

## A. The coordinate Wirtinger operators

The two coordinate Wirtinger operators are the directional Wirtinger derivatives
of `Wirtinger.Basic` along the I-th coordinate direction `Pi.single I 1`:

  dWirtingerCoord f I    = (1/2) · (∂_x − i · ∂_y) f
  dWirtingerAntiCoord f I = (1/2) · (∂_x + i · ∂_y) f

where `∂_x` and `∂_y` are the real Fréchet derivatives of `f` along the slot-I
real and imaginary coordinate directions `Pi.single I 1` and
`Pi.single I Complex.I` (the latter is `Complex.I • Pi.single I 1`). The sign on
the imaginary-direction term is the only difference, making the two operators
dual on (anti)holomorphic functions (§B, §C).

Each `∂_I` is thus a 1-D directional derivative taken along the standard basis vector
`Pi.single I 1` — the whole calculus is the one-variable theory applied direction by
direction. The coordinates decouple (`∂_I z^J = δ_IJ`, §B) because the coordinate functionals
`z^J` are the dual basis to the standard basis: `z^J (Pi.single I 1) = δ_IJ`.

-/

variable [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

/
def dWirtingerCoord (f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ) (I : ι) : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ
proof:
:=
  fun u => dWirtingerDir f (Pi.single I 1) u

name: dWirtingerCoord_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_apply {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ}
    {u : (ι → ℂ)} (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord f I u = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ f u (Pi.single I 1)
      - Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f u (Pi.single I Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerCoord, dWirtingerDir_apply, ← Pi.single_smul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_apply {f : (ι → ℂ) → ℂ}
    {u : (ι → ℂ)} (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord f I u = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ f u (Pi.single I 1)
      + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f u (Pi.single I Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dWirtingerAntiCoord, dWirtingerAntiDir_apply, ← Pi.single_smul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: clinear_of_holomorphic
statement:
private lemma clinear_of_holomorphic {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [IsScalarTower ℝ ℂ E] {f : E → ℂ} {u : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℂ f u) (d : E) :
    fderiv ℝ f u (Complex.I • d) = Complex.I • fderiv ℝ f u d
proof:
:= by
  rw [DifferentiableAt.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ hf, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    map_smul]

name: dWirtingerCoord_congr_of_eventuallyEq_apply
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_congr_of_eventuallyEq h (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_const
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerCoord_const (c : ℂ) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun _ : (ι → ℂ) => c) I = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u; exact dWirtingerDir_const c (Pi.single I 1) u

name: dWirtingerCoord_neg_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_neg_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)} (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun v => -(f v)) I u = -(dWirtingerCoord f I u)
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_neg f (Pi.single I 1) u

name: fderiv_coordProj
statement:
private lemma fderiv_coordProj (J : ι) (u d : (ι → ℂ)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => v J) u d = d J
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) J u).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]

name: dWirtingerCoord_coordProj
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerCoord_coordProj (I J : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun u : (ι → ℂ) => u J) I =
      fun _ => if I = J then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  rw [dWirtingerCoord_apply I, fderiv_coordProj, fderiv_coordProj]
  by_cases h : I = J
  · subst h; rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_same, if_pos rfl, Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
  · simp [h]

name: dWirtingerCoord_add_apply
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_add hf hg (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_smul_apply
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_smul c hf (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_mul_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_mul_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (f * g) I u =
      dWirtingerCoord f I u * g u + f u * dWirtingerCoord g I u
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_mul hf hg (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_fun_sum_apply
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_fun_sum hF (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_eq_complex_fderiv_apply
proof:
:= by
  show dWirtingerDir f (Pi.single I 1) u = fderiv ℂ f u (Pi.single I 1)
  rw [dWirtingerDir_eq_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hf _),
    DifferentiableAt.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ hf, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars']

name: conjCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] private lemma conjCLM_apply (u : ι → ℂ) : conjCLM u = star u
proof: := rfl

name: conjCLM_smul_I
statement:
private lemma conjCLM_smul_I (d : ι → ℂ) :
    conjCLM (Complex.I • d) = -(Complex.I • conjCLM (ι := ι) d)
proof:
:= by
  funext I
  simp only [conjCLM_apply, Pi.star_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.neg_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, star_mul', Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_I]
  ring

name: dWirtingerCoord_eq_zero_of_antiHolomorphic_apply
proof:
:= by
  have hgr : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (conjCLM u) := hg.restrictScalars ℝ
  change dWirtingerDir (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => g (conjCLM v)) (Pi.single I 1) u = 0
  rw [dWirtingerDir_comp_conjLinear conjCLM_smul_I hgr]
  exact dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_zero_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg _)

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_congr_of_eventuallyEq_apply
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerAntiDir_congr_of_eventuallyEq h (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_const
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_const (c : ℂ) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun _ : (ι → ℂ) => c) I = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u; exact dWirtingerAntiDir_const c (Pi.single I 1) u

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_neg_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_neg_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)} (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun v => -(f v)) I u = -(dWirtingerAntiCoord f I u)
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerAntiDir_neg f (Pi.single I 1) u

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_coordProj
statement:
@[simp] lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_coordProj (I J : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun u : (ι → ℂ) => u J) I = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  exact dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_zero_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℂ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℂ) J).differentiableAt _)

name: dWirtingerCoord_conjCoord
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_conjCoord (I J : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun u : (ι → ℂ) => star (u J)) I = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  exact dWirtingerCoord_eq_zero_of_antiHolomorphic_apply (g := fun w => w J)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℂ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℂ) J).differentiableAt I

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_conjCoord
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_conjCoord (I J : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun u : (ι → ℂ) => star (u J)) I =
      fun _ => if I = J then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : (ι → ℂ) => w J) u :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : ι => ℂ) J).differentiableAt
  rw [show dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun u : (ι → ℂ) => star (u J)) I u
      = star (dWirtingerCoord (fun w : (ι → ℂ) => w J) I u)
      from dWirtingerAntiDir_star_comp hd (Pi.single I 1), dWirtingerCoord_coordProj]
  simp only [apply_ite (star : ℂ → ℂ), star_one, star_zero]

proof:
:=

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_mul_apply

lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_mul_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (f * g) I u =
      dWirtingerAntiCoord f I u * g u + f u * dWirtingerAntiCoord g I u

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_fun_sum_apply

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_eq_complex_fderiv_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_eq_complex_fderiv_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (star u)) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => g (star v)) I u =
      fderiv ℂ g (star u) (Pi.single I 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hgr : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (conjCLM u) := hg.restrictScalars ℝ
  change dWirtingerAntiDir (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => g (conjCLM v)) (Pi.single I 1) u
      = fderiv ℂ g (star u) (Pi.single I 1)
  rw [dWirtingerAntiDir_comp_conjLinear conjCLM_smul_I hgr]
  simp only [conjCLM_apply, Pi.star_single, star_one]
  rw [dWirtingerDir_eq_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg _),
    DifferentiableAt.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ hg, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars']

:=

name: dWirtingerCoord_coordDiff
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_coordDiff (I J : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => v J - star (v J)) I
      = fun _ => if I = J then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  rw [coordDiff_eq_add_neg, dWirtingerCoord_add_apply (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) I,
    dWirtingerCoord_neg_apply I, dWirtingerCoord_coordProj, dWirtingerCoord_conjCoord]

proof:

    dWirtingerAntiCoord_neg_apply I, dWirtingerAntiCoord_coordProj, dWirtingerAntiCoord_conjCoord]

name: dWirtingerCoord_comp_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_comp_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (f u)) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun v => g (f v)) I u =
      dWirtingerDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerCoord f I u
        + dWirtingerAntiDir g 1 (f u) *
          dWirtingerCoord (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => star (f v)) I u
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerDir_comp hg hf (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerCoord_comp_holomorphic_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerCoord_comp_holomorphic_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (f u)) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerCoord (fun v => g (f v)) I u =
      deriv g (f u) * dWirtingerCoord f I u
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerCoord_comp_apply (hg.restrictScalars ℝ) hf I,
    dWirtingerDir_eq_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg 1),
    DifferentiableAt.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ hg, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv,
    dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_zero_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg 1), zero_mul, add_zero]

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_comp_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_comp_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (f u)) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun v => g (f v)) I u =
      dWirtingerDir g 1 (f u) * dWirtingerAntiCoord f I u
        + dWirtingerAntiDir g 1 (f u) *
          dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun v : (ι → ℂ) => star (f v)) I u
proof:
:=
  dWirtingerAntiDir_comp hg hf (Pi.single I 1)

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_comp_holomorphic_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_comp_holomorphic_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ g (f u)) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f u) (I : ι) :
    dWirtingerAntiCoord (fun v => g (f v)) I u =
      deriv g (f u) * dWirtingerAntiCoord f I u
proof:
:= by
  rw [dWirtingerAntiCoord_comp_apply (hg.restrictScalars ℝ) hf I,
    dWirtingerDir_eq_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg 1),
    DifferentiableAt.fderiv_restrictScalars ℝ hg, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_restrictScalars',
    fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv,
    dWirtingerAntiDir_eq_zero_of_clinear (clinear_of_holomorphic hg 1), zero_mul, add_zero]

name: dWirtingerAntiCoord_star_comp_apply
statement:
lemma dWirtingerAntiCoord_star_comp_apply {u : (ι → ℂ)}

name: QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_basis_vector
statement:
lemma QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_basis_vector {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
    [Module ℝ E] {weights : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → ℝ}
    {i : Fin (finrank ℝ E)} (v : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ j, v j = if j = i then 1 else 0) :
    QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ weights v = weights i
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (mem_univ i)]
  · simp [hv i]
  · intro j _ hj
    simp [hv j, hj]

name: neg_weight_implies_neg_value
statement:
lemma neg_weight_implies_neg_value {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {q : QuadraticForm ℝ E} {w : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → SignType}
    (h_equiv : QuadraticMap.Equivalent q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ fun i => (w i : ℝ)))
    {i : Fin (finrank ℝ E)} (hi : w i = SignType.neg) :
    ∃ v : E, v ≠ 0 ∧ q v < 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := Classical.choice h_equiv
  let v_std : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → ℝ := fun j => if j = i then 1 else 0
  refine ⟨f.symm v_std, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hz : v_std = 0 := by
      have hf := congrArg f h
      rwa [f.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at hf
    simpa [v_std] using congrFun hz i
  · have hw : QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ (fun j => (w j : ℝ)) v_std = (w i : ℝ) :=
      QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_basis_vector v_std fun _ => rfl
    rw [QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.map_app f.symm v_std, hw, hi, SignType.neg_eq_neg_one,
      SignType.coe_neg, SignType.coe_one]
    norm_num

name: posDef_no_neg_weights
statement:
lemma posDef_no_neg_weights {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    {q : QuadraticForm ℝ E} (hq : q.PosDef)
    {w : Fin (finrank ℝ E) → SignType}
    (h_equiv : QuadraticMap.Equivalent q (QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares ℝ fun i => (w i : ℝ))) :
    ∀ i, w i ≠ SignType.neg
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hq_neg⟩ := QuadraticForm.neg_weight_implies_neg_value h_equiv hi
  exact lt_asymm hq_neg (hq v hv)

name: rankNeg_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rankNeg_eq_zero {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
    [Module ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {q : QuadraticForm ℝ E} (hq : q.PosDef) :
    q.negDim = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (2 : ℝ) := inferInstance
  unfold QuadraticForm.negDim
  have h_exists := equivalent_signType_weighted_sum_squared q
  let w := Classical.choose h_exists
  have h_no_neg : ∀ i, w i ≠ SignType.neg :=
    QuadraticForm.posDef_no_neg_weights hq (Classical.choose_spec h_exists)
  simpa [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff] using h_no_neg

@[simp]
lemma flatL_surj

proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional ℝ (TangentSpace I x) := inst_tangent_findim x
  have : T2Space (TangentSpace I x) := inferInstanceAs (T2Space E)
  have h_finrank_eq : finrank ℝ (TangentSpace I x) = finrank ℝ (TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.symm.trans (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := TangentSpace I x) (F' := ℝ)).finrank_eq
  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank h_finrank_eq).mp (flatL_inj g x)
