  rw [normalOrderSign_cons_create φc' hφc', normalOrderSign_cons_create φc hφc]

name: normalOrderSign_swap_create_create
statement:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_create_create (φc φc' : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create) (hφc' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc' = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ φc :: φc' :: φs') = normalOrderSign (φs ++ φc' :: φc :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by
    exact normalOrderSign_swap_create_create_fst φc φc' hφc hφc' φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    rw [normalOrderSign]
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign, normalOrderSign_swap_create_create φc φc' hφc hφc']
    dsimp only [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    apply Or.inl (Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm _ _ _ _ _ _)
    exact List.Perm.append_left φs (List.Perm.swap φc' φc φs')

name: normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst
statement:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst (φa φa' : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (hφa' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa' = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    normalOrderSign (φa :: φa' :: φs) =
    normalOrderSign (φa' :: φa :: φs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalOrderSign, normalOrderSign]
  dsimp only [Wick.koszulSign]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [Wick.koszulSignInsert_cons, Wick.koszulSignInsert_cons, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  · dsimp only [Wick.koszulSignCons]
    rw [if_pos, if_pos]
    · simp [normalOrderRel, hφa, hφa', CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
    · simp [normalOrderRel, hφa, hφa', CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
  · rw [NonUnitalNormedCommRing.mul_comm]

name: normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate
statement:
lemma normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate (φa φa' : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (hφa' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa' = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderSign (φs ++ φa :: φa' :: φs') = normalOrderSign (φs ++ φa' :: φa :: φs')
  | [], φs' => by
    exact normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate_fst φa φa' hφa hφa' φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    rw [normalOrderSign]
    dsimp only [List.cons_append, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    rw [normalOrderSign_swap_annihilate_annihilate φa φa' hφa hφa']
    dsimp only [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign]
    rw [← normalOrderSign]
    simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff]
    apply Or.inl
    apply Wick.koszulSignInsert_eq_perm
    refine List.Perm.append_left φs ?h.h.a
    exact List.Perm.swap φa' φa φs'
open FieldStatistic

/-!

## Normal order of lists

-/

/
  `𝓕.normalOrderList φs` is the list `φs` normal-ordered using the
  insertion sort algorithm. It puts creation operators on the left and annihilation operators on
  the right. For example:

  `𝓕.normalOrderList [φ1c, φ1a, φ2c, φ2a] = [φ1c, φ2c, φ1a, φ2a]`
-/
def normalOrderList (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp
proof:
:=
  List.insertionSort 𝓕.normalOrderRel φs

name: normalOrderList_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_nil : normalOrderList (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalOrderList]

name: normalOrderList_statistics
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_statistics (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ (normalOrderList φs)) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalOrderList]

name: orderedInsert_create
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) → List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ φs = φ :: φs
  | [] => rfl
  | φ' :: φs => by
    simp only [List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
    rw [if_pos]
    dsimp only [normalOrderRel]
    rw [hφ]
    dsimp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]

name: normalOrderList_cons_create
statement:
lemma normalOrderList_cons_create (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    normalOrderList (φ :: φs) = φ :: normalOrderList φs
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort_cons]
  rw [orderedInsert_create φ hφ]

name: orderedInsert_append_annihilate
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_append_annihilate (φ' φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) → List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ' (φs ++ [φ]) =
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ' φs ++ [φ]
  | [] => by
    simp [normalOrderRel, hφ]
  | φ'' :: φs => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
    have hi
proof:
:= orderedInsert_append_annihilate φ' φ hφ φs
    rw [hi]
    split
    next h => simp_all only [List.cons_append]
    next h => simp_all only [List.cons_append]

name: normalOrderList_append_annihilate
statement:
lemma normalOrderList_append_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderList (φs ++ [φ]) = normalOrderList φs ++ [φ]
  | [] => by simp [normalOrderList]
  | φ' :: φs => by
    simp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort_cons]
    have hi
proof:
:= normalOrderList_append_annihilate φ hφ φs
    dsimp only [normalOrderList] at hi
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.insertionSort_cons]
    rw [hi, orderedInsert_append_annihilate φ' φ hφ]

name: normalOrder_swap_create_annihilate_fst
statement:
lemma normalOrder_swap_create_annihilate_fst (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate)
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    normalOrderList (φc :: φa :: φs) = normalOrderList (φa :: φc :: φs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalOrderList_cons_create φc hφc (φa :: φs)]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort_cons]
  have hi := normalOrderList_cons_create φc hφc φs
  rw [normalOrderList] at hi
  rw [hi]
  simp only [List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [normalOrderRel, hφa, hφc] at h
    dsimp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder] at h
  · rfl

name: normalOrderList_swap_create_annihilate
statement:
lemma normalOrderList_swap_create_annihilate (φc φa : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφc : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φc = CreateAnnihilate.create)
    (hφa : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φa = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderList (φs ++ φc :: φa :: φs') = normalOrderList (φs ++ φa :: φc :: φs')
  | [], φs' => normalOrder_swap_create_annihilate_fst φc φa hφc hφa φs'
  | φ :: φs, φs' => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, normalOrderList, List.insertionSort_cons]
    have hi
proof:
:= normalOrderList_swap_create_annihilate φc φa hφc hφa φs φs'
    dsimp only [normalOrderList] at hi
    rw [hi]

name: sum_normalOrderList_length
statement:
lemma sum_normalOrderList_length {M : Type} [AddCommMonoid M]
    (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (f : Fin (normalOrderList φs).length → M) :
    ∑ (n : Fin (normalOrderList φs).length), f n = ∑ (n : Fin φs.length), f (normalOrderEquiv n)
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm (Equiv.sum_comp normalOrderEquiv f)

name: normalOrderList_get_normalOrderEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_get_normalOrderEquiv {φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (n : Fin φs.length) :
    (normalOrderList φs)[(normalOrderEquiv n).val] = φs[n.val]
proof:
:= by
  change (normalOrderList φs).get (normalOrderEquiv n) = _
  simp only [normalOrderList, normalOrderEquiv]
  erw [← Physlib.List.insertionSortEquiv_get]
  simp

name: normalOrderList_eraseIdx_normalOrderEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalOrderList_eraseIdx_normalOrderEquiv {φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (n : Fin φs.length) :
    (normalOrderList φs).eraseIdx (normalOrderEquiv n).val =
    normalOrderList (φs.eraseIdx n.val)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalOrderList, normalOrderEquiv]
  rw [Physlib.List.eraseIdx_insertionSort_fin]

name: normalOrderSign_eraseIdx
statement:
lemma normalOrderSign_eraseIdx (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) (i : Fin φs.length) :
    normalOrderSign (φs.eraseIdx i) = normalOrderSign φs *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.get i), 𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.take i)) *
    𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.get i), 𝓕 |>ₛ ((normalOrderList φs).take (normalOrderEquiv i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eraseIdx, ← normalOrderSign]
  rfl

name: orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (createFilter φs ++ φs') =
    createFilter φs ++ List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ φs'
  | [], φs' => by simp [createFilter]
  | φ' :: φs, φs' => by
    rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ') with hφ' | hφ'
    · rw [createFilter_cons_create hφ']
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
      rw [if_neg, orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate φ hφ φs φs']
      simp [normalOrderRel, hφ, hφ', CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
    · rw [createFilter_cons_annihilate hφ', orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate φ hφ φs]

name: orderedInsert_annihilateFilter
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_annihilateFilter (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (annihilateFilter φs) =
    φ :: annihilateFilter φs
  | [] => by simp [annihilateFilter]
  | φ' :: φs => by
    rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ') with hφ' | hφ'
    · rw [annihilateFilter_cons_create hφ', orderedInsert_annihilateFilter φ φs]
    · rw [annihilateFilter_cons_annihilate hφ']
      simp only [List.orderedInsert.eq_2]
      rw [if_pos]
      dsimp only [normalOrderRel]
      rw [hφ']
      rcases CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ) with hφ | hφ
      · rw [hφ]
        simp only [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]
      · rw [hφ]
        simp [CreateAnnihilate.normalOrder]

name: orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate (φ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
    (hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    List.orderedInsert normalOrderRel φ (createFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs) =
    createFilter φs ++ φ :: annihilateFilter φs
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilate φ hφ, orderedInsert_annihilateFilter]

name: normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter
statement:
lemma normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter : (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    normalOrderList φs = createFilter φs ++ annihilateFilter φs
  | [] => by simp [normalOrderList, createFilter, annihilateFilter]
  | φ :: φs => by
    by_cases hφ : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.create
    · rw [normalOrderList_cons_create φ hφ φs]
      dsimp only [createFilter]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos]
      swap
      simp only [hφ, decide_true]
      dsimp only [annihilateFilter, List.cons_append]
      rw [List.filter_cons_of_neg]
      swap
      simp only [hφ, reduceCtorEq, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true]
      rw [normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter φs]
      rfl
    · simp only [normalOrderList, List.insertionSort_cons]
      rw [← normalOrderList]
      have hφ' : 𝓕 |>ᶜ φ = CreateAnnihilate.annihilate
proof:
:= by
        have hx := CreateAnnihilate.eq_create_or_annihilate (𝓕 |>ᶜ φ)
        simp_all
      rw [normalOrderList_eq_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter φs]
      rw [orderedInsert_createFilter_append_annihilateFilter_annihilate φ hφ']
      rw [createFilter_cons_annihilate hφ', annihilateFilter_cons_annihilate hφ']

name: crAnFieldOpToFieldOp_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma crAnFieldOpToFieldOp_prod (s : 𝓕.FieldOp) (t : 𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType s) :
    𝓕.crAnFieldOpToFieldOp ⟨s, t⟩ = s
proof: := rfl

name: length_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma length_eq (ψs : CrAnSection φs) : ψs.1.length = φs.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa using congrArg List.length ψs.2

name: head_state_eq
statement:
lemma head_state_eq {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} : (ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) →
    (ψs.1.head (by simp [← List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil])).1 = φ
  | ⟨[], h⟩ => False.elim (by simp at h)
  | ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
    exact h.1

name: statistics_eq_state_statistics
statement:
lemma statistics_eq_state_statistics (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ ψs.1) = 𝓕 |>ₛ φs
proof:
:= by
  erw [FieldStatistic.ofList_eq_prod, FieldStatistic.ofList_eq_prod, crAnStatistics]
  rw [← List.map_comp_map, Function.comp_apply, ψs.2]

name: take_statistics_eq_take_state_statistics
statement:
lemma take_statistics_eq_take_state_statistics (ψs : CrAnSection φs) n :
    (𝓕 |>ₛ (ψs.1.take n)) = 𝓕 |>ₛ (φs.take n)
proof:
:= by
  erw [FieldStatistic.ofList_eq_prod, FieldStatistic.ofList_eq_prod, crAnStatistics]
  simp only [List.map_take]
  rw [← List.map_comp_map, Function.comp_apply, ψs.2]

name: eq_head_cons_tail
statement:
lemma eq_head_cons_tail {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} {ψs : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)} :
    ψs.1 = ⟨φ, head ψs⟩ :: ψs.tail.1
proof:
:= by
  match ψs with
  | ⟨[], h⟩ => exact False.elim (by simp at h)
  | ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩ =>
    have h2 := head_state_eq ⟨ψ :: ψs, h⟩
    simp only [List.head_cons] at h2
    subst h2
    rfl

name: card_nil_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma card_nil_eq : Fintype.card (CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) []) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.ofEquiv_card nilEquiv.symm]
  simp

name: card_cons_eq
statement:
lemma card_cons_eq {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} :
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection (φ :: φs)) = Fintype.card (𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φ) *
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.ofEquiv_card consEquiv.symm]
  simp

name: card_eq_mul
statement:
lemma card_eq_mul : {φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp} → Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs) =
    2 ^ (List.countP 𝓕.statesIsPosition φs)
  | [] => by
    simp
  | FieldOp.position _ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, List.countP_cons_of_pos]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp only [fieldOpToCrAnType]
      erw [CreateAnnihilate.CreateAnnihilate_card_eq_two]
      ring
  | FieldOp.inAsymp x_ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.countP_cons_of_neg]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp [fieldOpToCrAnType]
  | FieldOp.outAsymp _ :: φs => by
      simp only [statesIsPosition, Bool.false_eq_true, not_false_eq_true, List.countP_cons_of_neg]
      rw [card_cons_eq]
      rw [card_eq_mul]
      simp [fieldOpToCrAnType]

name: card_perm_eq
statement:
lemma card_perm_eq {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs.Perm φs') :
    Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs) = Fintype.card (CrAnSection φs')
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_eq_mul, card_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  exact List.Perm.countP_congr h fun x => congrFun rfl

name: sum_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sum_nil (f : CrAnSection (𝓕 := 𝓕) [] → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection []), f s = f ⟨[], rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nilEquiv.symm.sum_comp]
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, PUnit.default_eq_unit, Finset.sum_singleton]
  rfl

name: sum_cons
statement:
lemma sum_cons (f : CrAnSection (φ :: φs) → M) [AddCommMonoid M] :
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection (φ :: φs)), f s = ∑ (a : 𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φ),
    ∑ (s : CrAnSection φs), f (cons a s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← consEquiv.symm.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rfl

name: sum_over_length
statement:
lemma sum_over_length {s : CrAnSection φs} (f : Fin s.1.length → M)
    [AddCommMonoid M] : ∑ (n : Fin s.1.length), f n =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs.length), f (Fin.cast (length_eq s).symm n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (finCongr (length_eq s)).sum_comp]
  rfl

name: congr_fst
statement:
@[simp]
lemma congr_fst {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (congr h ψs).1 = ψs.1
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: congr_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma congr_symm {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') :
    (congr h).symm = congr h.symm
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: congr_trans_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma congr_trans_apply {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h1 : φs = φs') (h2 : φs' = φs'')
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (congr h2 (congr h1 ψs)) = congr (by rw [h1, h2]) ψs
proof:
:= by
  subst h1 h2
  rfl

name: take_congr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma take_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') (n : ℕ)
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (take n (congr h ψs)) = congr (by rw [h]) (take n ψs)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: drop_congr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma drop_congr {φs φs' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h : φs = φs') (n : ℕ)
    (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    (drop n (congr h ψs)) = congr (by rw [h]) (drop n ψs)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: append_assoc
statement:
lemma append_assoc {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') (ψs'' : CrAnSection φs'') :
    append ψs (append ψs' ψs'') = congr (by simp) (append (append ψs ψs') ψs'')
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [append]

name: append_assoc'
statement:
lemma append_assoc' {φs φs' φs'' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (ψs : CrAnSection φs)
    (ψs' : CrAnSection φs') (ψs'' : CrAnSection φs'') :
    (append (append ψs ψs') ψs'') = congr (by simp) (append ψs (append ψs' ψs''))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [append]

name: singletonEquiv_append_eq_cons
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [append, cons, singletonEquiv]

name: take_append_drop
statement:
@[simp]
lemma take_append_drop {n : ℕ} (ψs : CrAnSection φs) :
    append (take n ψs) (drop n ψs) = congr (List.take_append_drop n φs).symm ψs
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [take, drop, append]

name: congr_append
statement:
lemma congr_append {φs1 φs1' φs2 φs2' : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h1 : φs1 = φs1') (h2 : φs2 = φs2')
    (ψs1 : CrAnSection φs1) (ψs2 : CrAnSection φs2) :
    (append (congr h1 ψs1) (congr h2 ψs2)) = congr (by rw [h1, h2]) (append ψs1 ψs2)
proof:
:= by
  subst h1 h2
  rfl

name: congr_fst_append
statement:
@[simp]
lemma congr_fst_append {φs1 φs1' φs2 : List 𝓕.FieldOp} (h1 : φs1 = φs1')
    (ψs1 : CrAnSection φs1) (ψs2 : CrAnSection φs2) :

name: eraseIdxEquiv_apply_snd

lemma eraseIdxEquiv_apply_snd {n : ℕ} (ψs : CrAnSection φs) (hn : n < φs.length) :
    (eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn ψs).snd = eraseIdx n ψs
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [eraseIdxEquiv, appendEquiv, take, List.take_concat_get', List.length_take, drop,
    append, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, congr_fst, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, Equiv.coe_trans,
    Equiv.coe_prodComm, Equiv.coe_refl, Prod.map_apply, Function.comp_apply, Prod.swap_prod_mk,
    id_eq, Equiv.prodAssoc_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, eraseIdx]
  rw [Nat.min_eq_left (Nat.le_of_succ_le hn), Nat.min_eq_left hn, List.take_take]
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, le_add_iff_nonneg_right, zero_le, inf_of_le_left]
  exact Eq.symm (List.eraseIdx_eq_take_drop_succ ψs.1 n)

name: eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eq_take_cons_drop
statement:
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eq_take_cons_drop {n : ℕ} (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (hn : n < φs.length)
    (a : 𝓕.fieldOpToCrAnType φs[n]) (s : CrAnSection (φs.eraseIdx n)) :
    (eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a, s⟩ =
    congr (by
    rw [Physlib.List.take_eraseIdx_same, Physlib.List.drop_eraseIdx_succ]
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop n φs]) (append (take n s) (cons a (drop n s)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eraseIdxEquiv, appendEquiv, Equiv.symm_trans_apply, congr_symm, Equiv.prodCongr_symm,
    Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.prodCongr_apply, Prod.map_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
    take_congr, congr_trans_apply, drop_congr, Equiv.prodAssoc_symm_apply, Equiv.coe_refl,
    Equiv.prodComm_symm, Equiv.prodComm_apply, Prod.swap_prod_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk,
    congr_fst_append, id_eq, congr_snd_append]
  rw [append_assoc', singletonEquiv_append_eq_cons]
  simp only [List.singleton_append, congr_trans_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [congr_fst]
  have hn : (List.take n φs).length = n := by
    rw [@List.length_take]
    simp only [inf_eq_left]
    exact Nat.le_of_succ_le hn
  rw [hn]

name: eraseIdxEquiv_symm_getElem
statement:
@[simp]
lemma eraseIdxEquiv_symm_getElem {n : ℕ} (φs : List 𝓕.FieldOp) (hn : n < φs.length)

    getElem ((eraseIdxEquiv n φs hn).symm ⟨a,s⟩).1 n
    (by rw [length_eq]; exact hn) = ⟨φs[n], a⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eraseIdxEquiv_symm_eq_take_cons_drop, append, take, cons, drop, congr_fst,
    List.length_take, length_eq, inf_le_left, List.getElem_append_right]
  have h0 : n ⊓ (φs.eraseIdx n).length = n := by
    simp only [inf_eq_left]
    rw [← Physlib.List.eraseIdx_length _ ⟨n, hn⟩] at hn
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn
  simp [h0]

name: orderedInsert_swap_eq_time
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_swap_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (φs : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ (List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φs) =
    List.takeWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) φs ++ φ :: ψ ::
    List.dropWhile (fun b => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) φs
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φs, List.orderedInsert_eq_take_drop]
  have h1 (b : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : (crAnTimeOrderRel φ b) ↔ (crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b) :=
    Iff.intro (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h2 h) (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h1 h)
  simp [h1, List.takeWhile_append, List.takeWhile_takeWhile, List.dropWhile_append]
  intro x hx hxψ y hy
  simpa using List.mem_takeWhile_imp hy

name: orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time
statement:
lemma orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time {φ ψ φ': 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp} (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ)
    (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) : (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) → ∃ l1 l2,
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ' (φs ++ φ :: ψ :: φs') = l1 ++ φ :: ψ :: l2 ∧
    List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ' (φs ++ ψ :: φ :: φs') = l1 ++ ψ :: φ :: l2
  | [], φs' => by
    have h1 (b : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : (crAnTimeOrderRel b φ) ↔ (crAnTimeOrderRel b ψ)
proof:
:=
      Iff.intro (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h h1) (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h h2)
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.orderedInsert, ← h1 φ']
    by_cases h : crAnTimeOrderRel φ' φ
    · use [φ'], φs'
      simp [h]
    · use [], List.orderedInsert crAnTimeOrderRel φ' φs'
      simp [h]
  | φ'' :: φs, φs' => by
    obtain ⟨l1, l2, hl⟩ := orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time (φ' := φ') h1 h2 φs φs'
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.orderedInsert]
    rw [hl.1, hl.2]
    by_cases h : crAnTimeOrderRel φ' φ''
    · use φ' :: φ'' :: φs, φs'
      simp [h]
    · use φ'' :: l1, l2
      simp [h]

name: crAnTimeOrderList_swap_eq_time
statement:
lemma crAnTimeOrderList_swap_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (h1 : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (h2 : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) :
    (φs φs' : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) →
    ∃ (l1 l2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp),
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs ++ φ :: ψ :: φs') = l1 ++ φ :: ψ :: l2 ∧
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs ++ ψ :: φ :: φs') = l1 ++ ψ :: φ :: l2
  | [], φs' => by
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, List.nil_append, List.insertionSort]
    refine ⟨_, _, orderedInsert_swap_eq_time h1 h2 _, ?_⟩
    have h1' (b : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) : (crAnTimeOrderRel φ b) ↔ (crAnTimeOrderRel ψ b)
proof:
:=
      Iff.intro (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h2 h) (fun h => IsTrans.trans _ _ _ h1 h)
    simpa only [← h1', decide_not, List.foldr_cons] using orderedInsert_swap_eq_time h2 h1 _
  | φ'' :: φs, φs' => by
    obtain ⟨l1, l2, hl⟩ := crAnTimeOrderList_swap_eq_time h1 h2 φs φs'
    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, List.cons_append, List.insertionSort_cons] at hl ⊢
    rw [hl.1, hl.2]
    exact orderedInsert_in_swap_eq_time (φ' := φ'') h1 h2 l1 l2

lemma koszulSignInsert_crAnTimeOrderRel_crAnSection {φ : 𝓕.FieldOp} {ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
